plugins.description: DSH 插件：划选回答文字打注释，旁问一次性只读侧问
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-annotation

划选对话里的回答文字 → 就地写一句注释 → 输入框上方只留一个 `N 条注释` 胶囊，多条一起随消息发出。

## 交互

1. 在任意回答里划选一段文字。
2. 浮出的评论框里可以写备注，也可以留空（纯引用）。回车保存，Esc 取消。
3. 选中的文字就地保留淡色底纹，末尾挂一个编号圆点；点圆点可以再编辑那条注释。
4. 输入框上方出现 `N 条注释` 胶囊：**悬停或点击**才浮出详情卡（逐条删除、全部清除、点条目跳回原文），平时不占位。
5. 注释以单行文本写进草稿，自己按回车或点发送即可带上，不需要额外按钮。

## 草稿里长什么样

每条注释一行，紧跟在你自己写的文字后面：

```
〔注释 1〕「你要的是旧版「六根线跳动」的」｜备注：这句按旧版改
```

草稿是唯一事实来源：你在输入框里删掉这一行，胶囊里的那条也会同步消失；消息发出去之后同样自动清理。

## 实现要点

- 浮层挂在 `shell.overlay`（整帧浮层，压在对话滚动容器之上），高亮用 `Range.getClientRects()` 计算、绝对定位覆盖绘制，**不改动被选中的 DOM**，所以回答流式重绘时不会破坏原文。
- 胶囊挂在 `conversation.input.dock`（输入框上方一整条）。
- 发送走 `inputActions.captureInsertion() / insertText()`，失败时回退 `setDraft()`，最后 `submit()`。
- 摘录保留选区的富文本（只放行 `code/strong/em/b/i/span/br`，其余标签降级为纯文本），所以行内代码在列表里仍然是代码样式；用户备注保持纯文本。
- 注释的 Range 失效（换会话、消息重渲染、被压缩）时自动丢弃，不会留下指向空气的高亮。

## 已知边界

- 按 Enter 或点自带发送键的消息**不会**带上注释——没有 pre-submit 钩子可用，必须在胶囊里点「带注释发送」。
- 注释只存在于当前页面内存，刷新即消失。
- 划选必须落在非输入区域；composer 里的选区会被忽略。

## 卸载

在 Plugins 设置里停用 `dsh-annotation`，或从 profile 移除该 bundle。


## 侧边对话

选中文字 → 点「侧边对话」→ 把选中内容（含已排队的注释）复制到剪贴板，并直接开一个
侧边对话标签页（调用 `betterSidebar.openTab({ type: 'sidechat' }, { sessionId })`，
线程由 better-sidebar 自己创建），随后把选中内容（含注释）直接写进它的输入框。

写入方式：等待侧栏挂载后，找到 class 含 `sidechat` 的 `contenteditable`，聚焦后
用 `execCommand('insertText')` 写入；若编辑器拒绝，则退化为派发一个 `paste` 事件。
两条都失败时剪贴板里仍有内容，手动粘贴即可。

为什么不能用接口写入：`dsh-better-sidebar` 的服务只暴露 `openTab / closeTab /
registerTab` 这些面板管理方法，线程创建与发消息走它内部的 `ctx.connection` RPC，
没有对外接口，插件无法代发。

## 旁问（第三个选项）

选中文字 → 点「旁问」→ 弹出模态：标题「旁问这段内容」、可展开的「引用原文」、
「你想了解什么？」输入框，底部是 取消 / 解释一下 / 发送旁问。

发送后模态关闭，回答以**卡片形式出现在消息流里**（挂在
`conversation.chat.turnTail`），不是浮在角落：卡片头部是问题、可折叠引用、
下方正文按**增量流式**追加（`POST /dsh-annotation/ask` 返回 NDJSON，每帧
`{delta}`，收尾 `{done}`）。

host 侧用 `subagents.getProvider('fork')` 起一次性子会话、下
`tools.restrict({allow: []})` 禁用全部工具，回答完即 `dispose`，不写主会话历史。
这条 fork 流水线参考 `@michengai/dsh-btw`（Apache-2.0），见 `NOTICE`。

## 安装

```bash
# 在 DSH 里以本地 bundle 安装（会写进当前 profile 并即时生效）
plugin_manager install_bundle /绝对路径/dsh-annotation
```

安装后划选任意回答文字即可看到工具栏。

## 已知限制

- 注释以单行文本写进输入框草稿，不是输入框内的独立胶囊（消息节点类型由 DSH 核心固定，插件无法新增）。
- 旁问的答案目前是「收尾时整段推送」，尚未做到逐字增量：`activation.result` 只给最终结果。
- 侧边对话只能打开标签页并复制内容；better-sidebar 没有对外写入线程草稿的接口，DOM 写入会失败并在 15 秒后弹出诊断卡片。

## 许可

本项目以 **Apache License 2.0** 发布，见 `LICENSE`。

`lib/index.js` 的旁问 host 流水线改编自 [`@michengai/dsh-btw`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-btw)
（Copyright 2026 MichengAI，Apache-2.0），其许可原文见 `LICENSE-dsh-btw`，
改动说明与署名见 `NOTICE`。依 Apache-2.0 第 4 条，这两份文件必须随代码一起分发。

plugins.description: DSH「PPT 大师」模式：联网取材 · 模板化设计 · 一键生成精美 PPTX（python-pptx 真渲染）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ppt-master · DSH「PPT 大师」模式

[![CI](https://github.com/weijianguizhou/dsh-ppt-master/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/weijianguizhou/dsh-ppt-master/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-339933.svg)](package.json)
[![python-pptx](https://img.shields.io/badge/python--pptx-1.0%2B-3776AB.svg)](https://python-pptx.readthedocs.io/)

> 让 DSH 里的 Agent 变成一位演示顾问：**联网取材 → 立纲 → 选/建模板 → 一键生成真 PPTX → 设计审校 → 迭代**。
> 输出是 python-pptx 真实渲染的原生对象（文字框、图表、表格都能在 PowerPoint 里继续编辑），不是图片拼贴。

![示例 deck 预览](docs/preview.png)

---

## 一、这是什么

给 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/) 装一个「**PPT 大师**」会话模式与配套工具：

| 装完之后你得到 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 一个会话模式 | 新建会话时选「PPT 大师」，常驻大师人设 + 五步工作流 + 实时模板清单 |
| 五个工具 | `ppt_research` / `ppt_templates` / `ppt_build` / `ppt_lint` / `ppt_doctor` |
| 一个技能 | `ppt-master` 方法论手册（版式选择表、设计硬规则、反面清单、排障） |
| 八套模板 | 靛蓝商务、极简素白、深空科技、暖阳人文、青瓷东方、数据亮色、石墨黑白、深海蓝 |
| 十六种版式 | 覆盖封面、议程、KPI、图表、表格、时间线、2×2 矩阵、对比、金句、全出血大图等 |
| 八类原生图表 | 柱状、条形、折线、面积、饼、环、堆叠、**雷达**、**散点** |
| 质量闸门 | 设计审校器（结论式标题/要点上限/数字进图表/讲稿齐备…）+ 渲染后结构自检 |

## 二、安装

**前置条件**

- 已安装 DSH，且版本支持宿主插件与 bundle（`dsh plugin` 命令可用）。
- Node.js **≥ 20**（插件与工具走宿主 Node 运行）。
- Python **≥ 3.10**，并安装 `python-pptx>=1.0` 与 `pillow>=10`：

```bash
python -m pip install "python-pptx>=1.0" "pillow>=10"
```

> DSH 桌面版自带 Python 运行时，插件会自动探测；也可以设置 `DSH_PPT_PYTHON`
> 指向任意可用的解释器。

**安装插件**

```bash
# 从本地目录安装（推荐：源码目录即唯一真源）
dsh plugin add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-ppt-master

# 发布到 npm 之后也可以直接
dsh plugin add dsh-ppt-master
```

安装后**重启一次 DSH**，新建会话时在模式选择器里选「**PPT 大师**」。

**自检**

```text
ppt_doctor        # Python / python-pptx / Pillow / 字体 / 模板目录 / 各服务
```

模板画廊与健康检查（把 `<DSH_WEB_ADDR>` 换成你自己的 DSH Web 地址，如 `http://127.0.0.1:52707`）：

```text
<DSH_WEB_ADDR>/plugins/dsh-ppt-master/gallery      # 8 套模板配色/气质一屏看完
<DSH_WEB_ADDR>/plugins/dsh-ppt-master/templates    # 模板 JSON
<DSH_WEB_ADDR>/plugins/dsh-ppt-master/status       # 健康检查
```

## 三、五个工具

| 工具 | 作用 | 关键点 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ppt_research` | 联网取材 | `kind` = facts / images / palette / inspiration；`images` 会抓页面 `og:image`，返回可直接填进 deck 的图片 URL；无搜索密钥时可用 `urls` 直抓 |
| `ppt_templates` | 模板库 | `list / get / save / delete`；`save` 支持 `baseOn` 派生，只覆盖想改的字段 |
| `ppt_build` | **核心：生成 PPTX** | 内联 deck JSON 或 `deckPath`；同时输出全页预览 PNG；自动下载图片、cover 裁切、字号回落防溢出、生成后结构自检 |
| `ppt_lint` | 设计审校 | 给出 `score` 与「问题 → 改法」清单（必改 / 建议 / 可选） |
| `ppt_doctor` | 环境自检 | Python / python-pptx / Pillow / 字体 / 模板目录写权限 / 各服务可用性 |

## 四、怎么用

### 4.1 说人话

> 用 PPT 大师模式，帮我把这份季度复盘做成 12 页的汇报，先给提纲。

Agent 会按手册执行：**定受众/场合/决策目标 → 取材 → 立纲（标题句）→ 选模板 → 先出 3-5 页小样 → 补全 → 审校 → 交付**。

### 4.2 直接指挥工具

```text
ppt_templates  action=list
ppt_research   query="2026 新能源汽车渗透率"  kind=facts
ppt_build      template="ocean-deep"  deck={...}  out="D:\\报告\\q3.pptx"
ppt_lint       deck={...}
ppt_doctor     {}
```

### 4.3 deck 速查

```jsonc
{
  "title": "2026 增长战略", "subtitle": "董事会汇报", "author": "战略部", "date": "2026-10",
  "template": "indigo-corporate",
  "slides": [
    { "layout": "cover", "kicker": "战略规划", "title": "把增长押在三个确定性上",
      "subtitle": "渠道结构 × 产品组合 × 组织效率", "image": "https://…jpg", "notes": "开场 30 秒" },

    { "layout": "agenda", "title": "今天只讲三段",
      "agenda": [
        { "title": "现状",  "desc": "渠道与产品结构", "page": "P03" },
        { "title": "打法",  "desc": "下半年三件事",   "page": "P06" },
        { "title": "要什么", "desc": "回报与风险",     "page": "P14" }
      ] },

    { "layout": "kpi", "title": "三个数字定义今年的基线",
      "kpi": [{ "value": "12.4", "unit": "亿元", "label": "全年营收", "delta": "+18%", "hint": "口径：合并报表" }] },

    { "layout": "chart", "title": "增量几乎全部来自渠道结构变化", "insight": "直营占比 21%→38%，是主因",
      "chart": { "type": "bar", "categories": ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"],
                 "series": [{ "name": "直营", "values": [1.2, 1.9, 2.6, 3.4] }] } },

    { "layout": "chart", "title": "五个维度的能力对比", "insight": "短板在复购",
      "chart": { "type": "radar",
                 "categories": ["获客", "转化", "复购", "服务", "品牌"],
                 "series": [{ "name": "直营", "values": [9, 8, 5, 8, 9] },
                            { "name": "代理", "values": [6, 7, 6, 6, 5] }] } },

    { "layout": "chart", "title": "门店投入与回报的关系", "insight": "直营店回报更高",
      "chart": { "type": "scatter",
                 "series": [{ "name": "直营门店", "points": [{ "x": 420, "y": 3.1 }, { "x": 460, "y": 3.4 }] },
                            { "name": "联营门店", "points": [[230, 4.2], [260, 4.5]] }] } },

    { "layout": "matrix", "title": "四类增长机会的优先级", "insight": "预算优先给左上象限",
      "matrix": { "xAxis": "投入", "yAxis": "回报",
        "quadrants": [
          { "title": "先做（高回报·低投入）", "items": ["直营扩店", "续费率提升"] },
          { "title": "重点投", "items": ["海外第二供应通道"] },
          { "title": "顺手做", "items": ["包装升级"] },
          { "title": "暂缓", "items": ["自建物流"] }
        ] } },

    { "layout": "bullets", "title": "下半年只做三件事", "insight": "资源聚焦在回报最高的两件事上",
      "bullets": [{ "text": "直营门店从 180 家扩到 260 家", "level": 0 },
                  { "text": "把续费率从 78% 提到 85%", "level": 0 }] },

    { "layout": "end", "title": "要一个决定：批准 Q3 的 1.2 亿扩张预算", "contact": "战略部 · 王明" }
  ]
}
```

字段约定：

- `notes`：讲稿，写进 PPT 备注（每页 2-4 句）。
- `insight`：这一页的结论句（图表/要点页必填，观众不用自己猜）。
- `image`：本地路径或 `http(s)` URL（自动下载 + cover 裁切，不拉伸）。
- `agenda`：3-6 条；`{title, desc, page}`，纯字符串数组也可以。
- `matrix`：必须 4 个象限，顺序为**左上、右上、左下、右下**；`xAxis` / `yAxis` 可选。
- `chart.type`：`bar`｜`column`｜`bar-h`｜`line`｜`area`｜`pie`｜`doughnut`｜`stacked`｜`radar`｜`scatter`。
  - 分类类图表：`categories` 与每个 series 的 `values` 数量必须一致；
  - `scatter`：不要 `categories`，用 `series[].points`（`[{x,y}]` 或 `[[x,y]]`，每个系列 ≥ 2 个点），散点不支持数据标签。

### 4.4 模板与自建

| 模板 id | 气质 | 适合 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `indigo-corporate` | 靛蓝商务 | 汇报、融资、董事会 |
| `minimal-paper` | 极简素白 | 学术、评审、白皮书 |
| `deepspace-tech` | 深空科技 | 技术发布、产品架构 |
| `warm-sunrise` | 暖阳人文 | 品牌、文化、内部沟通 |
| `celadon-cn` | 青瓷东方 | 东方美学、政府/文化项目 |
| `data-vivid` | 数据亮色 | 数据看板式汇报 |
| `graphite-mono` | 石墨黑白 | 正式打印、省墨、黑白复印友好 |
| `ocean-deep` | 深海蓝 | 深色科技感、发布会 |

自建模板（`baseOn` 派生，只覆盖想改的字段）：

```text
ppt_templates action=save baseOn="minimal-paper" name="年度总结·墨绿" id="annual-ink"
  theme={"primary":"#2F6B5E","accent":"#C25E3A","bg":"#FBFAF7"}
  geometry={"marginX":1.0,"bodySize":16,"lineSpacing":1.4}
  decor={"style":"soft","coverPattern":"rule"}
```

单位：`geometry` 全部英寸、字号磅（pt）、颜色 `#RRGGBB`。
`decor.style` ∈ `glow | grid | soft | ink | none`；`decor.coverPattern` ∈ `orbs | grid | rule | arc | seal | bars`。
用户模板存在 `<DSH_HOME>/ppt-master/templates/*.json`，同 id 覆盖内置模板。

### 4.5 十六种版式

| layout | 用途 | 关键字段 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cover` | 封面 | title, subtitle, kicker, image, author, date |
| `section` | 章节转场 | index, title, subtitle |
| `agenda` | 议程/目录 | title, agenda[{title,desc,page}] |
| `bullets` | 要点页 | title, bullets[], insight |
| `two-col` | 左右两栏 | title, columns[{title,bullets[]}] |
| `cards` | 卡片并列 | title, cards[{title,body,icon,color}] |
| `kpi` | 大数字 | title, kpi[{value,unit,label,delta,hint}] |
| `timeline` | 时间线 | title, steps[{time,title,desc}] |
| `process` | 流程/步骤 | title, steps[{title,desc}] |
| `matrix` | 2×2 象限 | title, matrix{xAxis,yAxis,quadrants[{title,items[]}]} |
| `image` | 图文页 | title, image, variant(left/right/full), bullets[] |
| `quote` | 金句页 | quote, author, role |
| `table` | 表格 | title, table{head[],rows[][],widths[]} |
| `chart` | 图表 | title, chart{type,categories,series}, insight |
| `compare` | 优劣对比 | title, left{title,items[]}, right{title,items[]} |
| `end` | 收尾 | title, subtitle, contact |

别名自动归一：`title→cover`、`toc/contents/outline→agenda`、`grid→cards`、`stats→kpi`、
`roadmap→timeline`、`flow→process`、`photo→image`、`quadrant/quadrants/2x2→matrix`、
`thanks→end` 等。

### 4.6 示例与 Showcase

- `examples/demo-deck.json`：9 页，覆盖常用版式，设计审校 **100/100**，是仓库的「活文档」——
  `tests/node/example-deck.test.js` 会校验页数、版式覆盖、图表系列、表格列对齐与讲稿齐备。
- `examples/showcase-deck.json`：18 页，覆盖**全部 16 种版式**与柱状 / 雷达 / 散点三类图表，
  使用 `ocean-deep` 模板；README 顶部的预览图就是它渲染出来的。

```bash
# 渲染 demo（默认）
node scripts/render-example.mjs

# 渲染 18 页 showreel
node scripts/render-example.mjs --deck examples/showcase-deck.json --out examples/out/showcase-deck.pptx
```

## 五、开发

### 5.1 目录结构

```text
dsh-ppt-

plugins.description: DSH 官方客户端没有的两个按钮：重启和刷新。一个很小的独立插件。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH App Controls

DSH 官方客户端有一个小小的遗憾：**没有“重启”和“刷新”按钮**。

每次装完插件、改完配置，流程基本是：关掉窗口，重新打开，然后祈祷它还记得刚才改了什么。为了不再做这套仪式，我写了这个插件。

它在会话标题栏和 **设置 → 应用** 里放了两颗按钮：

- **重启 DSH**：结束当前应用和后台 Host，再通过 WMI 在用户会话中无控制台启动它。
- **刷新页面**：只重新加载当前页面，后台服务继续运行。

没有新的服务，没有复杂的配置，也没有“企业级解决方案”。就是两个按钮。

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:dingdong2333333-lab/dsh-app-controls
```

从本地目录安装：

```bash
dsh plugin add <本目录>
```

从打包产物安装：

```bash
dsh plugin add ./dsh-app-controls-1.0.0.tgz
```

安装后按钮会出现在会话标题栏和 **设置 → 应用**。首次使用“重启”会关闭并重新打开整个应用。

## 这两个按钮做什么

### 重启 DSH

桌面端会启动一个 WMI worker，把重启动作放到当前 Electron 进程树之外，然后结束应用与 Host，再重新拉起应用。这样即使当前窗口被关掉，worker 也不会被一起带走。

重启会中断正在运行的任务；会话记录和工作区文件不受影响。

### 刷新页面

只在客户端执行 `location.reload()`。Host 不重启，页面会重新从 Host 读取状态。适合刚装完插件、想让界面重新拉取数据的场景。

## 一些细节

- 运行日志：`~/.dsh/logs/dsh-app-controls.log`
- 重启路由带 15 秒冷却，避免连点导致进程互相踩踏。
- Windows 桌面版使用 WMI 启动独立 worker；`dsh web` 下改用结束旧进程、以原命令行拉起新宿主的方式。
- 如果重启后应用没有自动回来，手动打开应用，再看一眼上面的日志。
- 这个插件不修改 DSH 本体，也不接管你的会话和工作区。

## 开发

```bash
npm pack
```

产物 `dsh-app-controls-1.0.0.tgz` 可以直接用 `dsh plugin add` 安装。

源码结构：

```text
index.js              Host half：状态、重启路由、WMI/进程 worker
client.js             Client half：标题栏与设置页按钮
cordis.patch.yml      DSH 插件挂载声明
locale/*.json         中英文文案
icon.svg              图标
```

## 许可证

本插件使用 [Unlicense](LICENSE) 释放到公共领域。DSH 是 DeepSeek 的产品；本项目是独立插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

# dsh-ai-armor > **AI 写代码后,一次性定位 5 类常见生产事故的"护甲"。** 一次安装,5 个工具,8 个 tool slot,都是给"AI 写完代码"那一刻准备的——stack trace 来了、解码;git 出 bug 了、二分定位;config 改坏了、校验;shell 命令拼错了、跨平台转义;MyBatis Plus SQL 写糙了、静态审计。 ## 这个 bundle 里有什么 | 子插件 | 工具 | 解决的生产问题 | |--------|------|----------------| | **[dsh-when-broke](./plugins/dsh-when-broke/README.md)** | `when_broke_find_introducer`
`when_broke_recent_changes`
`when_broke_bisect_with_repro`
`when_broke_blame_age` | 这段代码从哪个 commit 来的?最近谁动过这个文件?线上 bug 是哪个 commit 引入的?这行代码新写的还是老的? | | **[dsh-stackdecoder](./plugins/dsh-stackdecoder/README.md)** | `decode_stack` | AI 拿到一段堆栈文本,1 次调用解析出每帧 file:line + 上下文代码片段,不用逐帧 read_file 来回问 | | **[dsh-config-guard](./plugins/dsh-config-guard/README.md)** | `validate_config` | AI 改完 application.yml / .env / .properties 后,验证有没有重复键、tab 缩进、键名打错、缺必需字段 | | **[dsh-cmd-shield](./plugins/dsh-cmd-shield/README.md)** | `build_shell_invocation` | AI 拼 shell 命令经常被引号/`$`/CJK/路径空格搞坏(尤其 Windows),这个工具替 agent 做转义,POSIX/PowerShell/cmd 各家规则都对齐 | | **[dsh-mp-auditor](./plugins/dsh-mp-auditor/README.md)** | `audit_mp_code` | 扫 MyBatis Plus 项目,挑出 N+1 / 漏 `@Transactional` / `LIKE '%xxx%'` / `SELECT *` / 缺 WHERE 的 UPDATE/DELETE | ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin add AAAlenwow/dsh-ai-armor ``` 或者先克隆再 link: ```bash git clone https://github.com/AAAlenwow/dsh-ai-armor.git cd dsh-ai-armor pnpm link --global # 或 npm link ``` 每个子插件都可以**单独安装**(如果你只需要其中一个): ```bash dsh plugin add AAAlenwow/dsh-when-broke # 4 个工具 dsh plugin add AAAlenwow/dsh-stackdecoder # 1 个工具 dsh plugin add AAAlenwow/dsh-config-guard # 1 个工具 dsh plugin add AAAlenwow/dsh-cmd-shield # 1 个工具 dsh plugin add AAAlenwow/dsh-mp-auditor # 1 个工具 ``` ## 为什么打包 这 5 个工具解决的问题有一个共同特征:**都是 AI 写完代码后那一刻最容易爆雷的地方**。 - 堆栈一贴,AI 不会自动定位本地代码 → `decode_stack` - `git blame` / `git bisect` 在 shell 里跑可以但需要 AI 拼命令和解析输出 → `when_broke_*` - YAML/ENV 写错一个 tab 或一个重复键,服务启动失败 → `validate_config` - Windows PowerShell 跟 bash 转义规则不一样,AI 经常写错 → `build_shell_invocation` - MyBatis Plus N+1 不会报错但会拖慢数据库,AI 自己看不到 → `audit_mp_code` **一个 bundle,一个 PR,一个 review,搞定 8 个 tool slot。**比 5 次单独发布少 4 轮审核往返,普通用户一次安装全有。 ## 性能(全本地,无外部依赖) 每个工具都是**纯本地、无网络调用、无第三方依赖**(只用 Node.js 内置 `fs`/`path`/`child_process`/`crypto`)。所有测试跑在普通 MacBook M1 上: | 工具 | 典型 latency | 输出大小 | 适用场景 | |------|-------------|---------|---------| | `when_broke_find_introducer` | 15-300ms | ~1-2KB | 出 bug 后,反查可疑代码的来源 | | `when_broke_recent_changes` | 5-30ms | ~1-2KB | 出 bug 后,看最近谁改过这个文件 | | `when_broke_bisect_with_repro` | 1-60s(取决于 repro) | ~2-3KB | 出 bug 后,二分定位第一个坏 commit | | `when_broke_blame_age` | <10ms | ~150 字节 | 一行代码是不是新写的 | | `decode_stack` | <1ms/帧 | ~2-5KB(10 帧) | 拿到堆栈,定位到本地代码 | | `validate_config` | <1ms | ~500-700 字节 | CI 前置检查、agent 自检 | | `build_shell_invocation` | <2ms | ~120-380 字节 | AI 拼 shell 命令前先转义 | | `audit_mp_code` | <10ms/1000 文件 | ~1-2KB | 写完 MyBatis Plus 代码后扫描 | ## 不在范围内 - **不执行任何代码 / 不发起网络请求** — 全部离线运行,适合企业内网 - **不依赖任何 npm 包** — 装上就能用,版本兼容问题为零 - **不替你"自动 fix"** — 给出 finding + suggestion,具体修改由人或 AI agent 自己来 - **不替代 IDE 静态分析** — IDE 看的是开发时实时反馈,这些工具是"AI 写完那一刻的最后一公里" ## 测试 每个子插件有自己的测试 harness,`cd plugins//tests && node run.mjs` 跑一遍。 bundle 自身的 smoke test: ```bash cd tests && node run.mjs ``` 应输出 `✅ All 8 expected tools registered. Bundle is loadable.` ## 致谢 - 设计参考了 `dsh-tool-pwsh-safe`(PowerShell 单工具)的思路 - ORCHESTRA 验证流程复用了本仓库的 `ORCHESTRA-PROGRESS.md` 7 步法 ## License MIT ## Standalone sub-plugins Every tool in this bundle is also published as a standalone installable plugin: | Repo | Tools | |---|---| | [dsh-when-broke](https://github.com/AAAlenwow/dsh-when-broke) | 4 — when_broke_find_introducer / when_broke_recent_changes / when_broke_bisect_with_repro / when_broke_blame_age | | [dsh-stackdecoder](https://github.com/AAAlenwow/dsh-stackdecoder) | 1 — decode_stack | | [dsh-config-guard](https://github.com/AAAlenwow/dsh-config-guard) | 1 — validate_config | | [dsh-cmd-shield](https://github.com/AAAlenwow/dsh-cmd-shield) | 1 — build_shell_invocation | | [dsh-mp-auditor](https://github.com/AAAlenwow/dsh-mp-auditor) | 1 — audit_mp_code | Install either the bundle or the standalone packages, not both (tool ids would collide).

plugins.description: Guardrail for DSH llm/stream: detects when model reasoning or text degenerates into a periodic repetition loop and aborts the request instead of streaming until you give up.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-loop-guard

在 `llm/stream` 上装一道刹车：模型把思考（或正文）退化成重复循环时，立刻中断本次请求，而不是一直吐到用户手动放弃。

## 为什么要它

一次真实会话（DeepSeek flash 档模型，经第三方兼容网关接入）里的两次卡死：

| 位置 | reasoning 产出 | 耗时 | 结局 |
|---|---|---|---|
| turn 56 step 2 | 26,021 字符 / 8,604 行 | 32 s | 用户中断 |
| turn 57 step 1 | 82,524 字符 / 28,512 行 | 96 s | 用户中断 |

turn 57 那一轮的行内容里只有 47 种不同行，约 87% 是 `写。` / `执行。` / `**写 pwsh**。` / `好，执行。` 这类无内容标记。它全程只发生在 `reasoning-delta` 里，正文与工具调用都是 0，因此：

- `repeat-tool-reminder` 只看「同名工具 + 相同参数」，永不触发；
- `maxTokens` 是 50,000 且有巨大余额，不会命中；
- `agent-loop` 不做流内重复检测。

唯一的刹车是用户点中断。这个插件补上这一环。

## 两道检测器

1. **行级塌缩（主力）**：按行切开增量，维护最近 `lineWindow` 条「有内容的行」。窗口塞满后，若不同行的种类数 ≤ `maxUniqueLines`，判定塌缩。本次故障几百行内就会撞线。
2. **字符周期重复**：把末尾 `probeChars` 个字符当指纹，在最近 `regionChars` 字符里数它出现几次，达到 `minOccurrences` 判定退化。用于抓没有换行的循环。
3. **绝对上限**（默认关）：单次请求累计输出超过 `maxTotalChars` 字符直接掐断。

空行与 trim 后长度 < `lineMinChars` 的行（单个 `}` 之类）不计入行统计，避免代码文件被误判。

## 命中之后

抛出一个 `code: 'repetition-loop'` 的错误（`onDetect: 'throw'`，默认）。agent-loop 本来就有「流中途出错」的完整清理路径（网络断流天天发生），会把它收成 `error finish`；`code` 用自定义值可以避免落进 `llm-retry` 的可重试码表，免得在同一个退化点上反复重试烧 token。

`onDetect: 'end'` 则静默结束流（不伪造 `block-end` / `finish`）。

## 配置

| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `providers` / `models` | `[]` | 空 = 全部；非空则只对列出的生效 |
| `lineWindow` | `400` | 行级检测窗口（行数） |
| `maxUniqueLines` | `40` | 窗口内不同行数上限 |
| `lineMinChars` | `2` | 短于它的行不计入 |
| `lineCheckEvery` | `20` | 每新增多少行判一次 |
| `probeChars` | `96` | 指纹长度 |
| `regionChars` | `3072` | 回看窗口 |
| `minOccurrences` | `5` | 指纹重复几次算退化 |
| `minTotalChars` | `2048` | 累计输出超过这个量才开始字符检测 |
| `checkEveryChars` | `128` | 每累计多少字符判一次 |
| `maxTotalChars` | `0` | 绝对上限，0 = 关 |
| `onDetect` | `'throw'` | `throw` \| `end` |
| `dryRun` | `false` | `true` = 只记日志不掐断（校准用） |
| `logFile` | `''` | 非空则把命中追加写进该文件 |

## 验证

`node lib/index.js` 跑内置用例（含「长清单 / 长代码样文本不得误杀」）。

用原始会话数据离线回放（回放脚本依赖该会话归档，不随包发布）：

- seq 1670（82,524 字符 / 96 s）：**2,304 字符处掐断**，占全长 2.8%，≈2.7 s 生成量。
- seq 1662（26,021 字符 / 32 s）：4,736 字符处掐断，≈5.5 s。
- 同一会话另外 327 个正常块（reasoning + 正文，共 588,930 字符）：**0 误杀**。
- 把 5 个正常块各自放大到 20 万字符：仍 0 误杀。

## 安装 / 回滚

```
plugin_manager set_plugin  target=dsh-loop-guard  enabled=false
```

改动只在 `llm/stream` 一条水位线上，且每次请求独立状态，禁用后立即恢复原样。

plugins.description: Interactive cards for DeepSeek Harness replies: sliders, forms, charts and tables from a tool result, with actions that flow back to the agent.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tool-cards

[中文](#中文) | [English](#english)

## 中文

**为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供交互式聊天卡片。**

在一条助手消息内直接渲染滑块、下拉、分段控件、日期选择器、表单、图表和表格——用户按下提交按钮后，参数快照会作为新消息回传给智能体。

> [!NOTE]
> 这是 `chat-ui/1.0` 消息格式的独立实现，不是任何官方 ChatGPT 协议，也不复现任何私有实现。

### 它做什么

```
模型调用 chat_ui({ title, ui })
  → host 校验载荷（组件白名单、深度、节点数、action 形状）
  → 工具结果 meta 携带 { kind: 'chat-ui/1.0', title, ui }
  → 卡片被"提升"为最终聊天输出（不折叠进工具过程）
      拖动 / 勾选 / 输入 → 仅本地状态，零请求
      按下提交按钮   → POST /chat-ui/action { actionId, operation, values }
  → host 通过 agent.followup() 把它变成一条用户消息
  → 智能体在下一轮看到参数快照
```

### 为什么卡片要被"提升"

`chat_ui` 是一次工具调用，而工具结果通常属于 *process* 区段——模型思考结束后 DSH 会把这一段折叠起来，卡片也会跟着消失。所以 client 端注册了一个由 `tool/result` 事件驱动的自定义聊天节点（`chat-ui-card`），锚定到会话输出流上；工具行则降级为一行占位符加一个原始数据展开。

如果 `uiConversation` 不可用，插件会回退为在工具行内渲染卡片，功能仍然可用。

### 组件

共 26 种注册组件：

| 分组 | 类型 |
|---|---|
| 输入 | `Slider` `Checkbox` `Radio` `Select` `Segmented` `Input` `Textarea` `Date` `Button` |
| 容器 | `Form` `Pressable` `Popover` `Carousel` |
| 视觉 | `Chart`（柱/线/饼/散点）`Map` |
| 展示 | `Card` `Metric` `Text` `Heading` `Row` `Column` `Divider` `Badge` `Alert` `Table` `KeyValue` |

表达式使用白名单 JSON AST——`{ op: "mul", args: [{ var: "a" }, { var: "b" }] }`，支持 `add`/`sub`/`mul`/`div`/`round`/`eq`/`and`/`or`/`not`。**没有 eval，不生成代码。**

### 安装

```bash
# 在你的 DSH profile 里
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tool-cards
```

或在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 中手动加入 bundle 行：

```json
{ "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-tool-cards"] } } }
```

然后重启 DSH（profile patch 在启动时读取）。

### 用法

`chat_ui` 工具会出现在模型的工具集里。它的描述告诉模型何时使用它（调参数、多维对比、"给我做个计算器"），何时不该用（纯解释、一次性结论）。

最小载荷示例：

```json
{
  "title": "药剂投加量计算器",
  "ui": {
    "schemaVersion": "chat-ui/1.0",
    "initialState": { "soilTons": 1000, "doseGPerKg": 2 },
    "tree": {
      "id": "root",
      "type": "Card",
      "props": { "title": "药剂投加量" },
      "children": [
        { "id": "soil", "type": "Input", "label": "土壤质量 (t)", "bind": "soilTons",
          "props": { "inputType": "number", "min": 0 } },
        { "id": "dose", "type": "Slider", "label": "投加量 (g/kg)", "bind": "doseGPerKg",
          "props": { "min": 0.1, "max": 5, "step": 0.1 } },
        { "id": "total", "type": "Metric", "label": "理论药剂质量", "props": { "unit": "t" },
          "value": { "op": "round", "args": [
            { "op": "div", "args": [
              { "op": "mul", "args": [{ "var": "soilTons" }, { "var": "doseGPerKg" }] }, 1000
            ] }, 3 ] } },
        { "id": "submit", "type": "Button", "label": "提交这次配比", "actionId": "apply" }
      ]
    },
    "actions": {
      "apply": {
        "kind": "submitToAgent",
        "operation": "apply-dose",
        "includeKeys": ["soilTons", "doseGPerKg"]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Action 类型：`submitToAgent`、`callTool`、`openUrl`（仅 http/https）。

### 按钮与文案约定

- 提交按钮是卡片**唯一的出口**：全宽、加粗、上方有分隔线。
- 按钮文案描述**用户的下一个动作**，由模型按当前任务决定——"应用这组参数""计算推荐投加量""提交这次配比"。

### 限制

每条消息：≤ 120 个节点，树深度 ≤ 8，≤ 60 个状态键，≤ 20 个 action，文本 ≤ 4000 字符。由 host 强制执行，畸形载荷在到达 client 前就会被拒绝。

### 说明与注意事项

- `Chart` 和 `Map` 是手绘 SVG。`Map` 只做坐标投影示意，不连接任何瓦片服务。
- client bundle 将 `react` 保持为 external（由 host 提供），内联了 `@json-render/*` 和 `zod`，因为它们不在平台模块基线里。
- 样式只使用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，自动跟随亮/暗主题。

### 开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/wszw142857-beep/dsh-tool-cards
cd dsh-tool-cards
npm install
npm run build     # 重新生成 src/card-css.js 和 lib/client.js
npm run check     # protocol + bundle 自测
```

更多测试工具在 `tools/`（不随 npm tarball 发布）：

| 脚本 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `tools/selftest.mjs` | 15 项检查：协议校验、bundle 导出面、提升机制、回归防护 |
| `tools/bundle-rehearsal.mjs` | 10 项检查：在 static-plugin 上下文中运行 `apply()`，含/不含 `uiConversation` |
| `tools/e2e-full.mjs` | 全链路：真实工具定义 → 事件定义 → 真实 React 渲染 → 拖动 → 提交 |
| `tools/preview.mjs` | 渲染真实 bundle 并输出可直接截图的页面 |

## English

**Interactive chat cards for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).**

Render sliders, selects, segmented controls, date pickers, forms, charts and tables **inside an
assistant message** — then send the resulting parameter snapshot back to the agent when the user
presses the submit button.

> [!NOTE]
> This is a standalone implementation of the `chat-ui/1.0` message format. It is not an official
> ChatGPT protocol and does not reproduce any private implementation.

### What it does

```
model calls chat_ui({ title, ui })
  → host validates the payload (component whitelist, depth, node count, action shapes)
  → tool result meta carries { kind: 'chat-ui/1.0', title, ui }
  → the card is promoted to final chat output (not folded into the tool process)
      dragging / checking / typing → local state only, zero requests
      pressing the submit button  → POST /chat-ui/action { cardToken, actionId, operation, values }
  → host resolves the card token to its owning session, then agent.followup()
  → the agent sees the parameter snapshot on its next turn
```

### Why the card is "promoted"

`chat_ui` is a tool call, and tool results normally belong to the *process* section, which DSH
collapses once the model finishes thinking — taking the card with it. So the client registers a
custom chat node (`chat-ui-card`) driven by the `tool/result` event and anchors it to the session
output stream. The tool row degrades to a one-line placeholder plus a raw-data disclosure.

If `uiConversation` is unavailable, the plugin falls back to rendering the card inside the tool row,
so the feature still works.

### Action ownership (security)

The client **never** says which session an action belongs to. At execute time the host records
`card → session` and hands the client an opaque `cardToken` through `presentationMeta`; the action
route accepts only that token and ignores any `sessionId` in the request body.

An earlier version trusted `body.sessionId` and resolved it with `agents.get()`, which let any
same-origin page inject a user message into *any* session. `tools/security-test.mjs` now pins the
behavior: forged `sessionId` → 403, unknown token → 403, valid token + forged session → routed to
the token's own session, released session → 409.

If the host cannot determine the owner session, the tool issues no token and the card renders
read-only — it never guesses a target.

### Components

26 registered component types:

| Group | Types |
|---|---|
| Inputs | `Slider` `Checkbox` `Radio` `Select` `Segmented` `Input` `Textarea` `Date` `Button` |
| Containers | `Form` `Pressable` `Popover` `Carousel` |
| Visuals | `Chart` (bar/line/pie/scatter) `Map` |
| Display | `Card` `Metric` `Text` `Heading` `Row` `Column` `Divider` `Badge` `Alert` `Table` `KeyValue` |

Expressions use a whitelisted JSON AST — `{ op: "mul", args: [{ var: "a" }, { var: "b" }] }` with
`add`/`sub`/`mul`/`div`/`round`/`eq`/`and`/`or`/`not`. **No eval, no generated code.**

### Install

```bash
# in your DSH profile
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tool-cards
```

Or add the bundle row yourself in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`:

```json
{ "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-tool-cards"] } } }
```

Then restart DSH (a profile patch is read at startup).

### Usage

The `chat_ui` tool appears in the model's tool set. Its description tells the model when to reach
for it (parameter tuning, multi-dimensional comparison, "build me a calculator") and when not to
(pure explanation, one-shot answers).

A minimal payload:

```json
{
  "title": "药剂投加量计算器",
  "ui": {
    "schemaVersion": "chat-ui/1.0",
    "initialState": { "soilTons": 1000, "doseGPerKg": 2 },
    "tree": {
      "id": "root",
      "type": "Card",
      "props": { "title": "药剂投加量" },
      "children": [
        { "id": "soil", "type": "Input", "label": "土壤质量 (t)", "bind": "soilTons",
          "props": { "inputType": "number", "min": 0 } },
        { "id": "dose", "type": "Slider", "label": "投加量 (g/kg)", "bind": "doseGPerKg",
          "props": { "min": 0.1, "max": 5, "step": 0.1 } },
        { "id": "total", "type": "Metric", "label": "理论药剂质量", "props": { "unit": "t" },
          "value": { "op": "round", "args": [
            { "op": "div", "args": [
              { "op": "mul", "args": [{ "var": "soilTons" }, { "var": "doseGPerKg" }] }, 1000
            ] }

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-usage-analytics

一款给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）用的**本地用量分析插件**：订阅会话事件，把工具调用、回合、错误、耗时与能力使用情况聚合成日表，在侧栏面板里展示，并对外提供一套本地 HTTP 查询接口。默认 **local 模式、零出站**，不采集任何消息正文。

![插件图标](icon.svg)

> 配图说明：上图是本插件随包发布的 `icon.svg`（32×32，侧栏与插件列表共用）。面板截图需要在宿主加载插件后由本机浏览器截取，见 [`docs/design-mapping.md`](docs/design-mapping.md) 的「验证状态」一节。

## 特性

- **零依赖**：纯 ESM JavaScript，只 `import` `node:` 内置模块（`node:crypto`），不需要 TS/打包工具链，装上即可跑。
- **三层幂等**：游标（`meta.cursors[sid]`）+ fork 起点（`inheritedEventCount`）+ 回填去重，重启、重载、fork 都不会重复计数。
- **脏表才写**：内存聚合 → 每 `flushIntervalMs`（默认 10s）只把脏表落盘，写放大可控。
- **可降级**：取不到 `storageDomain` 时自动切内存档，面板与接口照常工作，只是重启即丢（`diagnostics.storage.kind === 'memory'`）。
- **可关**：`collect:false` 停止采集，`selfExclude` 排除本插件的工具调用，`retentionDays` 控制保留天数（同时裁剪内存与落盘）。
- **围栏与限流**：`Host` 必须是回环名（`127.0.0.1`/`localhost`/`[::1]`，挡 DNS rebinding）+ `Sec-Fetch-Site` + `Origin`/`Host` 一致性校验，写方法面每秒 10 次上限，请求体 64KB 上限。

## 安装

正路（推荐）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:wjf1/dsh-plugin-usage-analytics
```

无需构建：`package.json` 声明了 `dsh.bundle`（`patch: ./cordis.patch.yml`）与 `dsh.client`（web UI），`lib/` 产物随仓库提交。

离线安装 / 手工等价（本机当前就是这种装法，等价于上面三步）：

1. 把包目录放进 profile 的 `node_modules`（Junction 或直接拷贝）：
   `C:\Users\admin\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-plugin-usage-analytics`
2. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里追加 `"dsh-plugin-usage-analytics"`（**不要**加进 `dependencies`，bundle 不需要 npm 解析）。
3. 重启 DSH（**新增 bundle 可以靠 HMR 加载，替换已装包必须重启**；本仓库采用 Junction，改动即时可见但首次加载仍需宿主扫到 bundle 列表）。

装好后打开侧栏「用量分析」即可看到面板；`GET /dsh-plugin-usage-analytics/api/` 应返回 `{"ok":true,"value":{"ready":true,...}}`。

## 配置

写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 段（也可在运行时通过设置接口热改，仅白名单键）：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `local` | `local` 只落本地；`remote`/`opt-in` 为未来上报预留，当前不产生任何出站流量 |
| `collect` | `true` | 总开关，`false` 时不再消费会话事件 |
| `sampleRate` | `1` | 采样率（0..1），按 `tool/call`+`tool/result` 成对抽稀，丢弃量记在 `meta.sampled` |
| `retentionDays` | `90` | 保留天数（1..400），定时任务按此裁剪 |
| `maxEventsPerDay` | `200000` | 单日事件上限，超出记 `meta.dropped` |
| `flushIntervalMs` | `10000` | 合并落盘间隔，最小 2000 |
| `layout` | `single` | 存储布局，`single` 整单元重写 / `per-record` 逐条写（小数据量更稳，大数据量注意小文件数量） |
| `selfExclude` | `false` | 是否排除本插件自身产生的调用 |
| `profileName` | `null` | 存储 domain 的 profile 后缀。默认自动探测（`config` → `profile` 服务 → `app.profile` → `DSH_PROFILE`/`DSH_PROFILE_NAME`/`DSH_PROFILE_DIR` → `--profile=` → `ctx.baseDir` 的 `profiles/<name>` → `default`），显式指定可保证多 profile 隔离 |

### 验证状态（真机）

| 检查项 | 结果 | 证据 |
|---|---|---|
| 宿主加载 bundle | ✅ | `diagnostics.version` 有值、`routes` 注册成功 |
| HTTP 前缀可达 | ✅ | `GET /dsh-plugin-usage-analytics/api/` → `ready:true`（签名 cookie 鉴权后） |
| 真实数据聚合 | ✅ | 1181 次调用 / 22 次错误 / 4 会话 / tokensIn 3,354,030 / avgMs 3505 |
| 存储落盘 | ✅ | `storage.kind=domain`、`writes=158`、`flushes=32`、`C:\Users\admin\.dsh\storages\plugin_analytics_default.json` 14KB |
| JSON-RPC 面 | ✅ | `POST /` 的 `diagnostics` 返回统一信封 |
| 客户端包注册 | ✅ | GUI boot 清单含 `dsh-plugin-usage-analytics/client.js` |
| 面板肉眼验收 | ⚠️ | 需重启宿主后在 GUI 侧栏确认（会话内无浏览器控制权） |

## 面板

侧栏入口「用量分析」，主面板包含：

- 6 张 KPI 卡：窗口内工具调用、错误数、错误率、平均耗时、会话数、tokens 进出；
- 14 日趋势柱状图（SVG 自绘，不引第三方图表库）；
- Top 工具表（调用数、错误数、平均耗时、占比）；
- 能力分布（MCP / skill 等非原生能力的调用占比条）；
- 设置区：`collect` 勾选、`sampleRate` 滑杆、`retentionDays` 数字框；
- 操作区：刷新、立即落盘、清空本地数据（二次确认）、窗口天数切换（1/7/14/30/90）。

配色只用宿主 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token（带回退值），跟随浅色/深色主题。

## HTTP 接口

前缀 `API_PREFIX = /dsh-plugin-usage-analytics/api`。

### JSON-RPC 方法面（设计 §7.5）

`POST <prefix>/`，请求体 `{ "method": "...", "params": { ... } }`，响应 `{ok:true,value}` 或 `{ok:false,error:{code,message,retryable?,detail?}}`。

| method | params | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `overview` | `{range}` | 4 KPI + 窗口汇总 + Top 工具 |
| `plugins` | `{range,q?,sort?,cursor?}` | 工具/能力榜，每页 50 |
| `plugin` | `{pluginId,range}` | 单工具逐日明细 |
| `capabilities` | `{range,type?,top?}` | 能力排行（mcp/skill） |
| `env` | `{range}` | 宿主与插件版本、存储状态 |
| `series` | `{range,metric}` | 逐日序列（calls/errors/sessions/turns） |
| `events` | `{limit?}` | 最近会话摘要（聚合粒度，见偏差说明） |
| `settings.get` / `settings.set` | `{}` / `{patch}` | 读/改设置（白名单） |
| `consent.get` / `consent.set` | `{}` / `{mode,version}` | 同意态（只支持 local/off） |
| `report.preview` / `report.now` / `report.clear` | `{}` | 上报预览/立即/清空（未启用上报，返回空载荷） |
| `data.delete` | `{confirm:'DELETE'}` | 删除本地全部数据 |
| `export` | `{range,format:'json'\|'csv'\|'ndjson'}` | 内联导出 |
| `diagnostics` | `{}` | 运行态诊断 |
| `reset` | `{}` | 清空并重扫 |

`range` 接受数字、`"7d"`、`{days}`、`{from,to}`，上限 366 天；错误码 `E_ORIGIN/E_RATE/E_RANGE/E_PAYLOAD/E_CONSENT/E_METHOD/E_INTERNAL` 映射到设计 §7.5 的状态码表。

### REST 便捷端点（面板使用）

`GET /`、`/overview?days=`、`/series?days=`、`/sessions?limit=`、`/tools?days=`、`/tool?name=&days=`、`/settings`、`/diagnostics`、`/export`（NDJSON 下载）；`POST /settings`、`/flush`、`/reset?confirm=RESET`。与 JSON-RPC 共用同一批聚合函数。

> 分页上限统一由 `lib/shared.js` 的 `PAGE_SIZE` / `MAX_PAGE_SIZE` 定义（REST 与 JSON-RPC 共用），`/sessions` 默认 20 条。
>
> `POST /reset` 与 RPC 的 `reset` 都必须显式带确认（`?confirm=RESET` / `params.confirm:"RESET"`），否则回 `E_CONFIRM`。

## 存储

每个 profile 一个 domain：`plugin_analytics_<profile 名>`（`storageDomain.open`），默认 `layout: 'single'`，落盘位置由宿主的 `DSH_HOME/storages` 决定。表：

- `meta`：`installId`、`settings`、`cursors`、`dropped`、`sampled`
- `daily`：按天的总量（toolCalls/toolErrors/turns/sessions/tokens/ms）
- `toolDaily`：`day + tool` 维度
- `capDaily`：`day + 能力键` 维度（MCP / skill）
- `sessions`：会话首见与累计（turns/toolCalls/errors/model）

## 隐私

- 只记录**事件元数据**：工具名、能力分类、成败、耗时、会话短哈希、模型名、回合/步数、token 计数。
- **不记录**：消息正文、工具参数原文、工具输出、文件路径、用户名、环境变量。
- 会话 ID 以 `sha256(sessionId + ':' + installId)` 截 16 位存储，卸载重装即换新 `installId`，历史无法互相拼接。
- 默认 `local` 模式，代码里没有任何出站请求（可 `grep -R "http" lib/` 自证：只有 `http://localhost` 的 URL 解析基线）。

## 开发

无构建步骤，直接改 `lib/*.js`：

```bash
node --test test/store.test.mjs test/aggregate.test.mjs test/collector.test.mjs \
           test/routes.test.mjs test/rpc.test.mjs test/index.test.mjs
```

75 条测试全通过。`node --test test/`（只给目录）在 Windows 上会报 `Cannot find module ...\test`，必须显式列文件。

## 已知限制

见 [`docs/design-mapping.md`](docs/design-mapping.md)：设计里的 `plugins`/`env`/`events`/`report`/SDK/上报通道在本实现中是**明确降级**（数据模型不含插件清单与逐事件行），逐条列了原因与替代方案。设计 v1.0 与评审报告不在本仓库内。

## 许可证

MIT。

---

# dsh-plugin-usage-analytics (English)

A local-only usage analytics plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It subscribes to session events, aggregates tool calls, turns, errors, latencies and capability usage into daily rows, renders them in a sidebar panel, and exposes a fenced local HTTP API.

![icon](icon.svg)

## Highlights

- **Zero runtime dependencies**: plain ESM JavaScript, only `node:` builtins; no build step.
- **Idempotent ingestion**: per-session cursor + `inheritedEventCount` fork boundary + backfill dedupe.
- **Write amplification control**: in-memory aggregation, dirty tables flushed every `flushIntervalMs` (default 10s).
- **Graceful degradation**: falls back to an in-memory store when `storageDomain` is unavailable (`diagnostics.storage.kind === 'memory'`).
- **Switches**: `collect`, `selfExclude`, `sampleRate`, `retentionDays`.
- **Fence + rate limit**: the `Host` header must be a loopback name (`127.0.0.1`/`localhost`/`[::1]` — this is what stops DNS rebinding), plus `Sec-Fetch-Site`/`Origin` checks, 10 writes per second, 64KB body cap.

> Image note: `icon.svg` (32×32) ships with the package and is used by both the sidebar and the plugin list. Panel screenshots must be taken in a local browser after the host has loaded the plugin; see the "validation status" section of [`docs/design-mapping.md`](docs/design-mapping.md).

## Install

Preferred: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:wjf1/dsh-plugin-usage-analytics` — `package.json` declares a `dsh.bundle` manifest (plus `dsh.client` for the web UI), so it installs with no build step.

Offline / manual equivalent:

1. Put the package directory into the profile's `node_modules` (junction or plain copy):
   `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-plugin-usage-analytics`
2. Append `"dsh-plugin-usage-analytics"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json` (**not** to `dependencies` — a bundle needs no npm resolution).
3. Restart DSH. A newly added bundle can activate through HMR; **replacing an installed package requires a restart**.

Once loaded, open "Usage Analytics"

# dsh-model-group-collapse

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web UI plugin that makes the **provider groups in the composer's model menu collapsible**.

![collapsed](./docs/preview.png)

## What it does

The stock model picker in the composer's tool row lists every provider group (DeepSeek Account, official endpoints, custom providers…) fully expanded. When you have many providers, the menu becomes a long wall of models.

This plugin adds a collapsible layer to that menu:

- Every provider heading becomes a **toggle with a triangle caret** (`▸` collapsed / `▾` expanded).
- **All groups start collapsed** by default.
- The **provider of the currently selected model starts expanded**.
- Click a heading to toggle that group; the caret flips and the group's models appear or disappear.
- While a **search query** is active, matched groups render expanded so results stay visible; clearing the query restores the collapse state.
- Everything else keeps working unchanged: the two-level "Model / Effort" menu, search, keyboard navigation, the pending spinner, and the official model-label badge (e.g. “1017”).

![expanded](./docs/preview-expanded.png)

Disable the plugin in the plugin manager and the menu returns to its stock appearance immediately.

## Install

### From a local checkout (development)

1. Put this folder somewhere stable.
2. In DSH, open the plugin manager and install the bundle from the local
   directory, or use the CLI equivalent:
   `dsh plugin install /path/to/dsh-model-group-collapse`
3. Reload the Web UI and open a conversation.

### From npm (after publishing)

```bash
dsh plugin install dsh-model-group-collapse
```

### From GitHub

```bash
dsh plugin install github:LinJohn8/dsh-model-group-collapse
```

## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2` (client plugin API `dsh.client`).
- Works on top of the shipped model picker: no component is replaced, so it
  follows the host's own state (streaming lock, pending selection, search
  filtering) instead of duplicating it.

## How it works

The shipped model menu renders its provider groups as
`section[data-menu-group]` elements, each with a
`[data-menu-group-heading]` label and `button[role="menuitemradio"]` rows.
The client half watches the document for that menu while it is open and
decorates each group:

- the heading gets a triangle caret and becomes a `role="button"` toggle;
- a collapsed group hides its model rows with `display:none` and reports
  `aria-expanded="false"`;
- collapse state is per group and resets on every menu open, using the
  current model's `aria-checked` row to pick the initially expanded group.

All styling is inline-scoped (`mgc-` prefix, `--dsw-alias-*` tokens), and every
DOM write is guarded by an equality check so the menu's own MutationObserver
never re-enters.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

**v0.10.4**（**残痕自检加二维形态判据**：以前只看「残留像素量」，会把 LaMa 修复后的纹理噪点当成残留水印 ⇒ 白降级整块重绘、糊掉 40–70% 的 ROI 却没换来更干净（真机实测 2/8 张中招）。现在要求「最大连通域 ≥1.4% ROI **且** 长宽比 ≥1.3」才算「像字」，17 例真样本全对。v0.10.3 起**订正生效方式**：改 `lib/*.js` 上、被插件整体丢弃 —— 用户看不到；v0.10.2 把它转发进插件日志。v0.10.1 新增**常驻度量日志**：每张图一行 `[wm_lama][metrics]`，写明走了哪条掩膜路径、命中率、残痕残留、ROI 改动面积、有没有渗出 ROI；并修掉「不带 `style` 调用会被判 invalid output」的输出 schema bug。上一版 v0.10.0 起⚡ 工具（列出/检索画风）。原有参数与行为**未变**。 > ⚠️ **v0.7.0 有行为变化**：默认 `imageRatio: "16:9"` 从「写进提示词的软生效」变成**真比例** ⇒ 默认出图尺寸从 `1344×1792`（3:4）变成 `2240×1248`（2K 16:9）。若你依赖旧的竖版默认，改传 `imageRatio: "3:4"`。 > > 🚨 **如果你装的是 驱动真实浏览器登录元宝网页版，复用**你自己账号**的会话。请自行评估账号风险（频繁调用、自动化行为可能触发平台风控），并遵守腾讯元宝的服务条款。作者不对账号受限、图片内容或版权负责。 ![去水印效果：左＝元宝原图（右下角水印），右＝开启 removeWatermark（Big-LaMa 修复）](docs/watermark-before-after.jpg) 上半＝整图对比，下半＝右下角 2× 放大（引擎内部自适应掩膜）。默认**不去水印**；开启后可去掉右下角「元宝 AI生成」，但放大仍能看到轻微平滑／修补痕（纸纹、白底类画面更明显）——所以默认关。掩膜两条路径（只修字形 / 整块矩形）的实测差别见下节 内部自适应掩膜。 ## 它做什么 - 工具名 `yuanbao_t2i`：传中文提示词 → 弹出/复用浏览器 → 走 `yuanbao.tencent.com` 的 `/api/chat/` SSE，从 `type=replace` 帧的 `multimedias[]` 取图 → 裸 `fetch` 下载 → 落盘 PNG。 - 传 `refImages`（本地文件 / URL / 文件夹，≤5 张）即走**图生图**：参考图由**元宝前端自己上传**（插件只负责把文件交给浏览器的上传控件），插件**不做任何签名**。 - 传 `style`（画风预设名）即**套用元宝官方模板库的画风**：模板库里 1000+ 条 `image2image` 模板，正文就是完整的画风描述（板绘/复古/野兽派/工笔重彩…），插件会把它剥好比例与指令前缀后追加到你的提示词后，并按模板自带的比例设定比例控件。 - 首次使用需**微信扫码登录**一次，登录态存在本地 profile 目录，之后复用。 - 同一个 profile 不能被两个浏览器同时打开，所以插件内部把所有调用**串行化**。 - 右下角「元宝 AI生成」水印可选去除，只用 `lama`（Big-LaMa 深度模型）。**默认不去水印**——实测 LaMa 在纸纹/白底图上仍有轻微平滑痕，看用途决定。（`telea` 引擎已于 v0.5.0 下架，理由见下文「为什么没有接入 MAT / ZITS」。） - `lama` 的**修复范围不再由用户选**（v0.10.0 撤下该开关）：引擎内部**自适应**（`auto`）——先按「位置先验 + 局部中值背景 + MAD 阈值」紧贴字形检出，膨胀后只修字形；检出**不可信**（命中率落在 [0.5%, 25%] 之外）时自动降级为整块矩形重绘，修完还会用同一套检测对输出图**自检残痕**，残留超标就用整块重绘兜底。实测两条路径差别很大——整块重绘在插画上会把窗口/砖石/水彩洗边糊掉，只修字形只留一道淡淡的修补痕。排障要强制某一档时可设环境变量 `DSH_WM_MASK=tight|rect`，平时不用管。 ## 内部自适应掩膜 掩膜模式（`tight` / `rect`）**v0.10.0 起是引擎内部实现、不再是用户开关**：默认 `auto` 在两者间选路，只有环境变量 `DSH_WM_MASK` 能强制。下面这张表是两条路径的实测差别（也是 `auto` 的选路依据），只影响 `lama` 引擎重修多大一块： | 模式 | 行为 | 实测（右图哥特城，1872×1248） | | --- | --- | --- | | `tight`（只修字形） | 在 ROI 内**自适应**检出字形（位置先验 + 局部中值背景 + MAD 阈值，见下节），膨胀 ~25px 后**只修字形**，再按羽化掩膜回填 | 改动 **0.63%** 像素（14,644 px）；砖缝／窗框／屋顶轮廓全部保留，只在水印原处留一道很淡的修补痕 | | `rect`（整块重绘） | 把 ROI 整块矩形交给 LaMa 重建 | 改动 **1.85%** 像素（43,321 px，约 3 倍）；塔身右侧一大片被抹平成雾状，窗户与尖顶细节丢失 | ![tight vs rect 对比：上排整图，下排水印区放大。tight 保住窗框与砖缝，rect 把塔身右侧糊成一片](docs/wm-mask-tight-vs-rect.jpg) **结论**：`auto` 默认走 `tight`（只修字形），绝大多数图用它就对了。`auto` 的判据是**命中率可信区间**：紧贴字形的检测命中率落在 [0.5%, 25%] 之外（低于＝没检出字、高于＝把背景当字），就自动降级 `rect`（整块重绘，重修面积变大）；修完还有一道**残痕自检**（用同一套检测重跑输出图，残留超 `max(0.4%, 35%×原始命中)` **且形态上「像字」**才用 `rect` 重修）。这些降级都是自动的，不需要你选。排障时想固定某一档，用环境变量 `DSH_WM_MASK=tight` / `rect`（见「环境变量」一节）。 ### tight 为什么能自适应 元宝水印是**半透明白**叠加：压在暗背景上是一圈**亮笔画**，压在白纸上则变成**暗笔画**（只比纸暗 3–9 个灰度级）。固定绝对阈值必然一头踩空——实测 `thr=185` 在纯白图上命中 **100%** 的 ROI，等于把整块背景当字形抹平（ROI 内 3.85%–9.51% 像素被改，文字上方的空白带 21.3% 被改）。 所以 `tight` 的检出必须**自适应**。v0.10.0 起的口径（`lib/wm_lama.py` v2 检测器）＝**位置先验 + 局部中值背景 + MAD 阈值 + 低饱和闸**： - **位置先验**：只在水印真正会出现的那块 ROI（`PRIOR_BOX`）里判定，别处不参与 ⇒ 不碰画面其余部分； - **局部中值背景**：每个像素跟它周围 `MED_K=41` 邻域的中值比，而**不是**跟全图比 ⇒ 纸纹／渐变背景不再被误当字形； - **MAD 阈值**：偏离门槛取 `max(6, 2.5×MAD)`，随图自身噪声水平浮动（噪声大的水彩图门槛自动抬高）； - **低饱和闸**：彩色像素不参与（水印是灰白叠加）。 - 命中率落在 `[MIN_HIT, MAX_HIT]`（`0.5%`–`25%`）之外 ⇒ `auto` 自动降级 `rect`；修完再用**同一套**检测跑一遍输出图做**残痕自检**（残留 ≥ `max(0.4%, 35%×原始命中)`）就用 `rect` 兜底重修。 **v0.10.0 实测（20 张真样本）**：`auto` 无一张降级，ROI 改动面积**均值 9.41%**，而强制 `rect` 是 **54.07%**（少 5.7 倍）；肉眼复核水彩／木纹／带鸟的水彩三类：`auto` 水印消失且纹理完好，`rect` 整块糊掉。 ### 日志里的常驻度量（v0.10.1 起 · v0.10.2 起真正可见） > 🐞 **v0.10.2 还修掉一个会让去水印「整体失败」的 bug**：中文 Windows 下 Python 子进程 > stdout 默认 **GBK**，而脚本日志里有 `⇒`（U+21D2）⇒ `UnicodeEncodeError` ⇒ 脚本退出码 1 > ⇒ 插件记 `去水印失败（保留原图继续）`，用户拿到的还是带水印原图。修法＝**两侧都钉 UTF-8** > （`wm_lama.py` 里 `sys.stdout.reconfigure`，插件 `spawn` 里传 `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8`）， > 并写进回归锁 ⑪（缺任何一侧都会红）。 > ⚠️ **v0.10.1 的一个疏漏（v0.10.2 修）**：这些度量行当时只打在 `wm_lama.py` 的 **stdout** 上， > 而插件里 `runPython()` 只把子进程输出收进局部变量、**整体丢弃** ⇒ 用户和排障者在插件日志里 > 一条也看不到，"常驻读数"等于没做（回归锁 ⑪ 现在就钉这一条：`cleanWatermark` 必须把 > `[wm_lama][metrics]` 转发给 `log()`，不许出现丢掉返回值的裸 `await runPython(...)`）。 去水印每张图都会打一行可机读的度量，**不用再另写脚本做 A/B**： ``` [wm_lama][metrics] name=yuanbao-...-0.png requested=auto used=tight degraded=none \ hit=0.0391 residual=0.0034 roi_changed=13.13 outside_px=0 mean_abs=0.11 [wm_lama][metrics-summary] n=4 tight=4 rect=0 degraded=0 roi_changed_mean=12.40 \ roi_changed_max=19.06 outside_px=0 ``` | 字段 | 含义 | 出问题时怎么看 | | --- | --- | --- | | `requested` / `used` | 请求的档（`auto`/`tight`/`rect`）与实际走的路径 | 两者不同＝发生了自动降级 | | `degraded` | 降级原因：`none` / `hit_low` / `hit_high` / `roi_invalid` / `empty_mask` / `empty_bbox` / `selfcheck` | 频繁出现 `hit_low` ⇒ 水印配色/位置变了，检测口径要重标定 | | `hit` | 字形命中率（占 ROI） | 想一眼判断「检测是否近空」——旧 bug 就是这里只有 0.07% 还照样往下走 | | `residual` | 残痕自检的残留率；`-1`＝没跑自检 | 逼近阈值（`max(0.4%, 35%×hit)`）说明修补不干净 | | `roi_changed` | ROI 内改动面积占比（`diff>6`） | 整块重绘路径通常 >50%，只修字形 5%–20%；数值突然变大＝退化 | | `outside_px` | ROI **外**改动像素数（正常恒 0） | **非 0 ＝有整图重建混进来了**，画面会被洗平 | | `mean_abs` | 全图平均绝对差 | 配合 `roi_changed` 看“改得狠不狠” | `outside_px` 是这里面最有用的一列：它比「水印有没有修掉」更早暴露退化——整图重建会把画面洗平，但日志和 CI 全绿，只有这个数会飙。 ![auto vs rect 对比：4 张真样本各取水印区，左＝带水印原图，中＝auto，右＝强制 rect。auto 水印消失且纸纹/木纹/云都还在；rect 把整块洗平](docs/wm-mask-auto-vs-rect.jpg) 该图为 **v0.10.4 按当前默认参数重新生成**（同一批 4 张 2K 水彩图，水印区放大 2×）。图上每栏标了实测 ROI 改动面积：**auto 均值 15.0%** ｜ **强制 rect 69.7%**（多 4.6 倍），且这一批 **auto 零降级**（4/4 都走「只修字形」）。ROI 外改动均为 **0**。 > 📌 **以下为历史读数，仅存档**：v0.8.1–v0.9.0 用的是**分位数检测器**（口径＝「ROI 亮度分布两端各出一候选：亮笔画 `p99.5−12`、暗笔画 `p0.5+12`，只有两端都检出才取命中面积更小的一端」）。该口径已于 v0.10.0 被上文的 v2 检测器取代——因为它出过一次真事故（见下方 v0.8.1 说明），且回归锁 ⑨ 现在**禁止代码里再出现分位数**。16 张样本实测（旧口径）： | 样本类型 | 固定 thr=185 | 自适应 | | --- | --- | --- | | 4 张白底宣纸图（ROI p50≈243） | 命中 97%–98%，背景被抹平 | 自动切**暗笔画**，命中 2.2%–3.0%，水印清掉、纸纹保留（背景区 std 7.99 → 7.89） | | 4 张纯白/近白图（ROI p50≥230） | 命中 82%–100% | 命中 0.0%–2.6% | | 8 张深底/水彩图 | 命中 0%–43% | 命中 0.6%–3.0%（无回归） | | 全样本 ROI 平均改动面积 | 19.5% | **8.4%** | > ⚠️ **v0.8.1 修正了「盲选空端」的缺陷**：v0.8.0 及更早是「取命中面

plugins.description: VNC client tab for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar — connects to any VNC/RFB server
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vnc-client

A VNC client tab for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) right sidebar.

It connects to **any** VNC/RFB server — not just the machine the harness runs on — through a
WebSocket-to-TCP bridge that runs in the Harness Host. Servers are saved from the plugin's own
page under **Settings → Plugins → dsh-vnc-client**.

![The Remote desktop tab connected to a server](docs/screenshot-connected.png)

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-vnc-client
```

Then restart the harness. A plugin bundle is composed at boot, so the tab does not appear until
the Host restarts.

To connect the sidebar guide's **Remote desktop** entry to a specific server, open
**Settings → Plugins → dsh-vnc-client**, add the server, and click **Test** to confirm it
answers before switching to it.

## What it does

- Opens a **Remote desktop** tab in the right sidebar, beside Files, Preview and Terminal.
- Speaks RFB 3.3/3.7/3.8 directly in the browser: Raw, CopyRect, Hextile, Tight and ZRLE
  rectangles; DesktopSize, ExtendedDesktopSize, LastRect and Cursor pseudo-encodings.
- Sends keyboard and pointer events back to the server, plus wheel, the server's cursor
  shape, and clipboard in both directions.
- Saves servers with an optional VNC password.

![Saved servers in the plugin's settings](docs/screenshot-settings.png)

## How it is put together

A DSH plugin is two halves in one package:

| Half | Where | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `src/host/index.js` | Mounts a WebSocket upgrade route and a `TypertRemoteService` for saving servers |
| Client | `src/client/app.js` | Registers the sidebar tab type, the settings seats, and the guide command |

A browser cannot open a raw TCP socket, so the Host accepts a WebSocket at
`/api/vnc/bridge?target=<id>` — authenticated by the same connection check the Gateway uses —
and pumps bytes to and from the VNC server. **The password is never put in the URL**: it travels
over the RPC channel and is resolved by the Host at connect time, so it stays out of access logs.

Servers live in `vnc-client/targets.json` under the Harness home, written `0600` in a `0700`
directory. The list RPC reports only whether a password is set, never the password itself.

### Encodings

`DecompressionStream` emulates persistent zlib, because Tight and ZRLE keep deflate state across
rectangles and a browser has no incremental inflater. VNC authentication needs DES, which Node
dropped and WebCrypto never had, so `src/client/rfb/des.js` implements it.

JPEG is deliberately **not** advertised: a Tight JPEG rectangle cannot be painted without a
separate decoder, and offering it would make the client pick an encoding it cannot draw.

## Development

```sh
node scripts/build.mjs     # src/ → lib/
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
```

`scripts/build.mjs` inlines the client's ES modules into the single factory body the harness
loads, and refuses to build a bundle containing a `jsx` call React would silently render as
nothing — a null props object, or children passed as trailing arguments where the runtime expects
a key. Both fail in the browser as an empty sidebar tab, far from the call that caused them.

The tests cover DES against FIPS vectors and OpenSSL, every supported encoding round-tripped
through an independently written encoder, the handshake against a real socket (including
one-byte-at-a-time fragmentation), the WebSocket server against Node's own client, and the
built bundle's contract.

## Licence

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: In-browser audio and video previews in the DSH right Sidebar, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek large files without opening a native app on the Host.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-media-web-preview

Play **video and audio inside the DSH right Sidebar** — including from a remote
browser, where the native **Open** button would otherwise launch QuickTime or
Music on the Host Mac.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-media-web-preview)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-media-web-preview)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-media-web-preview)](LICENSE)

## The problem

DeepSeek Harness's document preview renders text, Markdown, code, images, PDF,
HTML, Office documents and spreadsheets. It has no audio or video renderer, and
`mp4`, `mp3`, `wav`, `flac`, `ogg`, `m4a`, `aac`, `wma` and `opus` are listed as
known binary containers with no viewer. Opening one shows:

> Preview is not available for this file type yet. **Open**

`Open` asks the **Host** to launch the file in a native application. On the
machine running the Host that is fine; from a phone, another laptop, or a
Tailscale peer it opens a window on a screen you are not looking at.

## What this plugin does

It registers two document renderers, `video` and `audio`, and draws the
browser's native player in the preview pane. A companion Host route streams the
file with HTTP `Range`, so seeking works and a large video is never read into
memory or into the conversation.

- **Native controls** — play/pause, seek, volume, fullscreen (video), and the
  browser's own picture-in-picture where available.
- **Seek without downloading everything** — `206 Partial Content` +
  `Content-Range`; the player asks for the bytes it needs.
- **Remote-browser ready** — the URL is document-relative, so the same preview
  works under `http://127.0.0.1:3080`, a LAN address, a Tailscale MagicDNS name,
  or `tailscale serve` on port 80. No configuration.
- **Download / open in a new tab** — both actions sit under the player.
- **Localized** — English and Simplified Chinese dictionaries.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — one Host module and one browser bundle.

![A video playing in the right Sidebar preview pane, with the file path in the header](docs/preview-video.png)

![An audio file playing in the right Sidebar preview pane](docs/preview-audio.png)

## Formats

| Kind | Suffixes |
| --- | --- |
| Video | `mp4` `m4v` `webm` `ogv` `mov` `mkv` `avi` `mpg` `mpeg` `3gp` `3g2` `ts` `m2ts` |
| Audio | `mp3` `m4a` `m4b` `aac` `wav` `flac` `ogg` `oga` `opus` `weba` `aiff` `aif` `wma` `mid` `midi` |

Playback is the browser's decision: Chromium plays H.264/AAC MP4, WebM, Ogg and
most audio, but usually cannot decode Matroska (`.mkv`) or AVI. When a codec is
unsupported the player shows an explicit message and the download link rather
than failing silently.

## Install

From npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-media-web-preview
```

From a local directory:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-media-web-preview
```

`dsh plugin add` records the dependency **and** appends the package to
`dsh.profile.bundles`; the package ships `dsh.bundle.patch`, so no manual
`insert:` row is needed in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

The Host half hot-mounts into the running `dsh web`; **refresh the page once**
so the browser bundle enters the module graph. If your build only composes
plugins at boot, restart `dsh web` instead.

Then open any supported file in the Sidebar's **Files** tab. The native **Open**
menu stays available at the top.

## Why a second file route

DSH already has `GET /api/file`, used by the image and Markdown previews. It
always answers with a full `200`, **ignores `Range`**, and caps the response at
the attachment image limit (20 MB by default). That is fine for images and
hopeless for video: no seeking, and a large file just returns `413`.

Rather than change a shared route, this plugin adds a range-capable sibling:

| | `/api/file` | `/api/media` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full response | `200` | `200` |
| `Range` request | ignored (full `200`) | `206` + `Content-Range` |
| Seeking | must download the whole file | immediate |
| Byte cap | ~20 MB | bounded by the filesystem |
| Reads | whole file buffered | 1 MiB chunks via `ctx.fs.readByteRange` |

Both routes sit under `/api`, so the Connection service applies the same Host /
Origin check and browser-cookie authentication to both.

## Implementation

```
lib/index.js      Host: GET/HEAD /api/media, Range parsing, chunked streaming
lib/client.js     Browser: documentPreviews + sidebar.right.tab.document
cordis.patch.yml  bundle insert row
```

The browser half registers through `ctx.documentPreviews` with
`loading: 'renderer'` and declares the suffixes as binary so nothing falls back
to a text preview. The player reads the absolute path from the `file` resource
(`useResource(resourceAddress).value.absolutePath`), builds a document-relative
`api/media?path=…` URL, and calls `content.loaded(version)` once to end the
loading state.

The Host half registers `ctx.connection.fetch.register({ path: '/api/media',
methods: ['GET', 'HEAD'] })`. Requests resolve through `ctx.fs`, so the Host's
own file policy still applies; `parseRange` turns `Range` into a closed
interval. `416` carries `bytes */<size>`; `HEAD` returns headers only;
`download=1` adds an attachment `Content-Disposition`.

## Security

- The route lives under `/api`, so it inherits the same authentication and
  Host/Origin checks as every other DSH API. Unauthenticated requests get `401`;
  an untrusted Host gets `403`.
- Only absolute paths are accepted; there is no directory listing, and nothing
  bypasses the filesystem provider's resolution and access policy.
- Responses carry `Cache-Control: private, no-store` and
  `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.
- No telemetry, no outbound network requests, no runtime dependencies.

## Verified

- A 59.6 s MP4 plays and seeks to 40 s over a Tailscale MagicDNS URL.
- A 28.6 MB MP4 returns `413` on `/api/file` but `200` / `206` on `/api/media`.
- `Range: bytes=0-1023` returns `206`, `Content-Length: 1024`,
  `Content-Range: bytes 0-1023/<size>`.
- Unauthenticated requests return `401`; an invalid range returns `416` with
  `bytes */<size>`.
- An MP3 reads its metadata and seeks to 30 s.

## Compatibility

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` web composition, and later versions that keep providing
  `ctx.documentPreviews`, `sidebar.right.tab.document`, `ctx.connection.fetch`
  and `ctx.fs.readByteRange`.
- Node 22+.
- Also usable from the DSH desktop app: the in-app route is document-relative.

## Scope

This plugin focuses on the **stock right Sidebar** and **remote-browser
playback**. It does not provide playlists, subtitle tracks, playback-speed
controls, or inline media cards in the chat transcript — other community
plugins cover those. Playback behaviour is whatever the browser's native
controls provide.

## Development

```sh
npm test        # node --test: Range parsing and MIME mapping
```

There is no build step. `lib/client.js` is a hand-written module-loader bundle
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`) that requests only `react` and
`react/jsx-runtime`, so it uses the Host's own React.

End-to-end check: with the plugin installed in a DSH web instance, open a
supported file and confirm the `<video>`/`<audio>` element reaches `readyState`
`4` and that `currentTime` follows after a seek.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Wilson Cheng

DSH Compact Lane

A compact conversation view for DeepSeek Harness.
Keep the answer in focus. Expand the work behind it when you need it.

English · 简体中文

Quick start · Use with DSH · Development · Compatibility

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 · React 18 · Cordis 4 · Apache-2.0

Captured in the real DSH host with a local replay fixture. Click to view full size.

DSH Compact Lane is a standalone [Cordis](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that brings Vela's compact conversation layout to DeepSeek Harness. It takes over the existing **Chat / 对话** view; disabling it restores the host view. The screenshot shows sample replay content, including its sample test results. ## What changes - **A quieter conversation.** Reasoning and tool activity fold into a process row, with tool groups organized by assistant message. Expand them to inspect commands, results, checklists, and subagent entries. - **File changes with evidence.** Diff cards and file totals come from successful tool results. Multiple fragments for one file share a card; missing line numbers stay blank. - **Streaming that follows your reading.** New output follows the bottom until you scroll up. Jump back to the latest output or load earlier turns while preserving your reading position. - **Familiar host controls.** Keep DSH's original composer, Markdown renderer, code-block controls, file preview, reply copying, and conversation branching. ## Quick start You need **Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`**, **pnpm**, and an installed **DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`** with `dsh` on your `PATH`. The plugin uses React 18 and Cordis 4 supplied by the host. See the [DSH installation guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#quick-start) for host setup; this plugin is loaded from a local build and is not published to npm. ```sh git clone https://github.com/KryptonGao/dsh-compact-lane.git cd dsh-compact-lane pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm dev ``` `pnpm dev` builds the plugin and starts DSH on **port 3081**, using the repository's isolated **`.dev-home/`**. Open the local authentication URL printed in the terminal, then open a session's **Chat / 对话** view. Normal conversations use this development environment's own model configuration. To inspect the UI with fixed sample data, run `pnpm preview` instead and select **紧凑预览** in a session. For a real streaming pipeline without a model API key, see [keyless replay](#keyless-replay). ## Use with your existing DSH environment Build once, then start DSH with the overlay. Run these commands from the plugin repository: ```sh pnpm build dsh web --patch "$PWD/dev/overlay.yml" --no-open ``` This uses your current DSH environment's configuration and sessions. The overlay loads `../lib/index.js` relative to `dev/overlay.yml`; keep the checkout and build output in place. The existing **Chat / 对话** view becomes compact, without an extra compact-view tab.
Disable the plugin and restore the host view Stop the current server, then restart with the disabling patch applied last: ```sh dsh web --patch "$PWD/dev/overlay.yml" --patch "$PWD/dev/disabled.yml" --no-open ``` For the isolated development environment, use: ```sh DSH_HOME="$PWD/.dev-home" dsh web --patch ./dev/overlay.yml --patch ./dev/disabled.yml --no-open --port 3081 ``` Remove the disabling patch and restart to enable the compact view again. Overlay-loaded plugins currently do not appear as switches in the host's plugin manager.
## Development All three launch commands use port 3081. Stop the previous server before switching modes. There is no hot reload: rebuild and refresh the browser after source changes. - **`pnpm dev`** — the production plugin in the isolated DSH environment, with real host sessions. - **`pnpm preview`** — fixed component samples under **紧凑预览**, including reasoning, grouped tools, diffs, terminals, checklists, subagents, and failure states. - **`pnpm replay`** — the production view driven by the official DSH replay provider, without a model API key. ### Keyless replay Create the recorded session once, then start the replay environment: ```sh pnpm seed pnpm replay ``` Open **紧凑界面测试录制** and send any test message. The first replay turn streams reasoning, runs a `printf` command through the host tool pipeline, and emits a long answer. The second stays active for stop, refresh/reconnect, and scrolling checks. The replay configuration disables live model providers and the title model; it makes no model API calls. `pnpm seed -- --long` creates a separate 100-turn session for pagination checks. Seed IDs are fixed; repeating a seed reports that the session already exists rather than replacing its history. The seed script also writes three demo files under `dev/workspace/src/`; keep personal code outside those fixture files. ### Validation Choose checks for the code you change: ```sh pnpm typecheck pnpm test -- tests/adapter.test.ts pnpm build ``` Replace the test path with the affected adapter, integration, lifecycle, or scrolling test. `pnpm test` runs the plugin's full test set. Recorded browser checks and unverified cases are listed in [VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/KryptonGao/dsh-compact-lane/blob/main/VALIDATION.md) (Chinese).
Architecture and style maintenance The data path is **host Chat nodes → per-turn adapter snapshots → React conversation view**. The plugin subscribes to host state; it does not change the host's event or persistence format. ```text src/ ├── client.tsx Host hooks, view registration, actions, and styles ├── integration.ts Chat-slot override and rc.2 tab compatibility ├── adapter/ Host snapshots, tool mapping, grouping, and diffs ├── ui/ Turns, tools, retained folds, and scroll behavior └── styles/ Scoped Vela styles and host integration rules dev/ Preview, replay, seed workspace, and overlay configs tests/ Adapter, integration, lifecycle, and scroll tests ``` Tool results are matched to assistant messages by `callId`. Successful `meta.diffs` are the source of file-change statistics; empty diffs are not reconstructed from call arguments, and failed results do not count as applied changes. Subagent navigation is offered only when the host's parent-session catalog confirms the session ID. Starting a subagent is not treated as completing it. Vela-derived CSS is checked in and scoped to `[data-dsh-compact-lane]`. A normal build needs no external reference checkout. To regenerate it, provide the Vela HTML reference explicitly: ```sh node scripts/extract-styles.mjs /path/to/compact-chat-ui.html pnpm build ``` The reference must contain the `vela-extracted` and `demo-chrome` style blocks. The extractor reads that file and rewrites `src/styles/vela-compact.css`; it does not edit the reference. The original extraction retained the order and values of 1,654 CSS declarations, with separately scoped dot-loader rules.
## Compatibility and limits - **Host version:** developed and checked against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`. Other versions are unverified; the chat-tab compatibility rule is specific to rc.2. - **Browser:** requires `:has()`, `color-mix()`, container queries, and `inert`, with no fallback. A narrow desktop content column was checked; full mobile

plugins.description: Live done-now-next card above the DeepSeek Harness composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-activity

[![ci](https://github.com/oxygenforce/dsh-agent-activity/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/oxygenforce/dsh-agent-activity/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![DeepSeek Harness plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that makes the agent's working process visible **while it is still working** — before the final answer lands.

The card docks right above the composer, in the same place as the todo panel, and answers three questions at a glance:

- **What has it already done?** Every tool call of the current turn, in order, with its target and how long it took (✓ / ✗ / spinner).
- **What is it doing now?** A phase label — *thinking*, *running a tool*, *writing the answer* — plus the current step number.
- **What is it about to do?** The tool calls the model has just announced but not yet run, followed by the next unfinished todo.

While the model streams a reply, the card also shows the leading edge of that reply, so you can tell the difference between "thinking", "stuck" and "writing".

It collapses to a single line (state persists across turns) and hides itself again once the turn has been finished for two minutes, so it never lingers over a finished conversation.

## Why a plugin and not a skill

A skill can only add instructions to the model's context; it cannot render anything. This is a UI plugin: a Host half that folds the session event log into a small "activity" projection, and a Client half that renders it in the Harness Web UI.

## Install

The package is a DeepSeek Harness bundle. Install it from a directory or from a packed tarball with the Plugin Manager:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=/path/to/dsh-agent-activity
```

`application: applied` means the Host half is live; the card appears above the composer in the Web UI. Replacing an already-installed version needs a Harness restart to pick up the new browser bundle.

There is nothing to configure. No data leaves the machine.

## What it renders

```
✓  Agent 动态               步骤 4/12   7 个工具 · 1分03秒   ⌃
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
📋 计划 2/5 项完成 · 接下来: 给 README 加上截图
✓  Bash   pnpm run build                                   12.4秒
✓  Read   lib/client.js                                     0.1秒
✗  Bash   node --test tests/                                3.0秒
⠋  Edit   lib/activity.js                                  1.2秒
… 之前的 3 步
接下来
○  Grep   "useProjection" in lib
○  TodoWrite  [{"content":"verify in the live UI"}]
✎  "Now I'll wire the plan row into the header…"
```

The glyphs and colors follow the Harness theme tokens, so light/dark and every accent color work unchanged. Everything is an ordinary React subtree inside the dock slot — no portals, no DOM outside the component.

## How it works

- **Host** (`lib/index.js`, `lib/activity.js`) registers the session projection `activity` with a single `apply(state, event)` fold over the durable event log: `turn/start`, `step/start`, `assistant/message`, `tool/call`, `tool/result`, `turn/end`. The fold is pure and synchronous, returns the same state reference for events it does not care about, and keeps a bounded log (32 tool calls) so long turns stay cheap.
- **Wire** (`wire.view`) hands the finished value to the Client. The Client never folds events itself — it reads `useProjection("activity")` and, for the plan row, the built-in `todos` projection.
- Because the projection is registered at boot and has no persisted rows yet, sessions restored from an older checkpoint simply re-fold their log through `init` + `apply`; no migration is needed.

The projection key is `activity`, and its state is plain JSON:

```ts
{
  v: 1,
  turn: number, step: number,
  phase: "idle" | "thinking" | "tool" | "writing" | "done" | "error" | "aborted",
  startedAt: number, updatedAt: number, endedAt: number | null,
  items: { id, name, target, status: "running" | "ok" | "error", t0, t1 }[],
  plan:  { id, name, target }[],
  draft: string,
  counts: { steps: number, tools: number, errors: number }
}
```

## Development

```bash
node scripts/check-manifest.mjs   # manifest, export map, patch row, icon, locales
node --test tests/activity.test.mjs
node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/activity.js && node --check lib/index.js
```

`tests/activity.test.mjs` replays synthetic session events through the fold and asserts the item list, plan, phase transitions, error accounting and the projection's wire identity — no browser required.

## Layout

```
lib/index.js       Host entry: registers the session projection
lib/activity.js    Pure event fold + tool-call summarizer (no dependencies)
lib/client.js      Web UI card, dictionaries, styles
locale/*.json      meta.title / meta.description for the Plugin Manager
icon.svg           Original artwork shown in the plugin list
cordis.patch.yml   Bundle patch row
```

## License

MIT © oxygenforce

plugins.readme_text:
# AI Stupid Level SDKs

Official clients for the [AI Stupid Level Smart Router](https://aistupidlevel.info/router), an
OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Each request goes to the model measuring best for that kind of work,
based on benchmarks that are re-run continuously. You call it with your own provider keys.

| Package | Install | Source |
|---|---|---|
| TypeScript / JavaScript | `npm install @aistupidlevel/router` | [packages/router](packages/router) |
| Python | `pip install aistupidlevel` | [python](python) |
| Vercel AI SDK provider | `npm install @aistupidlevel/ai-sdk-provider` | [packages/ai-sdk-provider](packages/ai-sdk-provider) |
| MCP server (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, …) | `npx -y @aistupidlevel/mcp` | [packages/mcp](packages/mcp) |
| n8n community node | Settings → Community Nodes → `n8n-nodes-aistupidlevel` | [packages/n8n-nodes-aistupidlevel](packages/n8n-nodes-aistupidlevel) |
| Raycast extension | Raycast Store (in review) | [integrations/raycast/aistupidlevel](integrations/raycast/aistupidlevel) |
| LangChain chat model (`ChatAISL`) | `pip install langchain-aistupidlevel` | [langchain-python](langchain-python) |
| Hermes Agent provider plugin | `hermes plugins install aistupidlevel` | [integrations/hermes/aistupidlevel](integrations/hermes/aistupidlevel) |
| DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle | `dsh plugin --profile web add @aistupidlevel/dsh-provider` | [packages/dsh-provider](packages/dsh-provider) |
| OpenClaw provider plugin | `openclaw plugins install clawhub:@aistupidlevel/openclaw-provider` | [packages/openclaw-provider](packages/openclaw-provider) |

[`openapi/router-v1.json`](openapi/router-v1.json) describes the API in OpenAPI 3.1, for generating a
client in any other language. The live copy is at <https://aistupidlevel.info/v1/openapi.json>.

## Quick start

```ts
import { ASLRouter } from '@aistupidlevel/router';

const router = new ASLRouter(); // ASL_ROUTER_KEY
const r = await router.chat.completions.create({ model: 'auto-coding', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Fix this bug: ...' }] });
console.log(r.choices[0].message.content, r.routing.model, r.routing.reasoning);
```

```python
from aistupidlevel import ASLRouter

router = ASLRouter()  # ASL_ROUTER_KEY
r = router.chat.completions.create(model="auto-coding", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Fix this bug: ..."}])
print(r.choices[0].message.content, r.routing.model, r.routing.reasoning)
```

## Why use an SDK instead of an OpenAI client

Any OpenAI client works against `https://aistupidlevel.info/v1`. The SDKs add:

- **Routing info** on every answer and stream: the model and provider that answered, why they were
  chosen, and whether a fallback answered.
- **Safe retries.** An automatic `Idempotency-Key` means a request is answered once, even if it is
  retried.
- **Typed errors** with `party` and `retryable`. An app can tell its user to top up, to fix a
  provider key, or simply to try again.
- `runTools` / `run_tools`, a tool-calling loop that stays on one model.
- **Sandbox mode** (mock answers through real routing, at no cost), route previews, and usage.

See the [API documentation](https://aistupidlevel.info/router/docs#sdks).

## Development

```sh
# TypeScript (the router package runs on Node 18+; the AI SDK provider needs Node 22+)
cd packages/router && npm ci && npm run build && npm test
cd packages/ai-sdk-provider && npm ci && npm run build && npm test
cd packages/mcp && npm ci && npm run build && npm test
cd packages/openclaw-provider && npm ci && npm test   # Node 24.16+, like OpenClaw
cd packages/n8n-nodes-aistupidlevel && npm ci && npm run build && npm run lint && npm test

# Python
cd python && pip install -e . && python -m unittest discover -s tests
```

The live tests run against the real router in sandbox mode, so nothing is spent. They need a router
key and are skipped without one:

```sh
ASL_ROUTER_KEY=aism_... npm test
ASL_ROUTER_KEY=aism_... python -m unittest discover -s tests
```

## Releasing

1. Bump the version in every place it appears:
   - `packages/router/package.json` and `packages/router/src/core.ts`;
   - `packages/ai-sdk-provider/package.json` and `packages/ai-sdk-provider/src/index.ts`;
   - `packages/mcp/package.json`, `packages/mcp/src/config.ts` and both versions in `packages/mcp/server.json`;
   - `python/src/aistupidlevel/_version.py`.
2. npm: `npm publish --access public` in each package directory. `prepublishOnly` builds the package
   and runs its tests first.
3. PyPI: `cd python && python -m build && twine upload dist/*`.
4. MCP Registry, after the npm release of `@aistupidlevel/mcp`: `cd packages/mcp && mcp-publisher login github && mcp-publisher publish`.
5. n8n node: n8n accepts only npm releases with provenance, so it is published by
   [`.github/workflows/n8n-publish.yml`](.github/workflows/n8n-publish.yml). Bump
   `packages/n8n-nodes-aistupidlevel/package.json` and its `CHANGELOG.md`, then push a tag `n8n-v<version>`.
6. Raycast: from `integrations/raycast/aistupidlevel`, `npm run publish` opens a pull request to
   raycast/extensions.

## Licence

MIT
