- 0.4.0：打开方式可**锁定**——右键菜单里先出现「用 X 打开（已锁定）」，其余应用仍在下面备选；末尾新增「其他程序…」调起 Windows 原生选择框（选过的应用 Windows 会记住，下次自动进列表）。锁定按**扩展名**存（`.md` → MarkText、`.txt` → 记事本），只影响本插件菜单，不改系统默认程序。
- 0.3.0：菜单可配置——右键菜单底部新增「菜单设置…」，勾选要显示的项（复制绝对路径 / 复制相对路径 / 用默认应用打开 / 打开方式列表 / 在资源管理器中显示），默认全开；文件管理器三档 `auto | explorer | custom`，保存即生效（写 `~/.dsh/better-right-click/config.json`）。新增 `GET/POST /file-menu/config`。
- 0.2.0：改名 **Better Right-Click**，npm 包名/仓库/客户端模块 id 全部改为 `dsh-better-right-click`（旧名 `@xmmtr/dsh-file-menu` 已弃用，功能相同）。
- 错误路径：缺文件 → `404 {"ok":false,"error":"not-found"}`；`Content-Type` 非 JSON → `415`；外部 Origin → `403`；`GET /file-menu/reveal` → `405`。
- 客户端（Edge headless + CDP，真实页面、真实 bundle）：菜单三项文案正确、复制得到 `C:\Users\86137\Desktop\workme\AGENTS.md`、`Esc`/点击外部关闭、正文空白与输入框不拦截。
- 卸载：`pnpm remove` + patch 还原 → 路由 404、`__DSH_BOOT__.entries` 从 70 降回 69、GUI 正常启动。

## 已知限制

- **真实会话正文里的文件引用未做自动化抓取**：无头浏览器里点侧栏会话行没有导航成功，所以「正文里实际渲染出的节点形态」是人工待验项；已用注入同形态节点（`<a href="AGENTS.md">`、`data-file-path` 卡片、`@AGENTS.md` 文本）在真实页面上验证。见 `TODO.md` T-01。
- **只对真正的文件引用生效**：正文里以普通文字出现的相对路径，必须是单个 token（不含空白）、含路径分隔符、末段带扩展名，才会被识别；带空格的文件名（未加 `@` / 未做成链接）不会被识别。
- 相对路径依赖会话工作区根（客户端从 DSH `sessions` 服务读，拿不到时退回宿主 `GET /file-menu/status` 的 `cwd`）；两者都拿不到时不猜，菜单不出现。
- 代码块（`pre`）、输入区、`contenteditable` 内部一律不拦截。
- Shadow DOM / canvas 渲染的文件引用不支持（按 `<a>`、`data-*` 与文本识别）。
- 只做定位与打开：**不读文件内容、不列举目录、不执行任意命令**。
- 宿主端 POST 路由要求同源（`Origin`/`Referer` 为本机回环，或 `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin`），其他来源 403。
- 中文菜单文案在 `lib/labels.js` 的 `LABELS`，英文待补（`TODO.md`）。

## 菜单配置

两种方式,二选一:

1. **界面里改**(推荐):右键任意文件引用 →「菜单设置…」→ 勾选要显示的项、选文件管理器 → 保存,立即生效,不用重启。配置落在 `~/.dsh/better-right-click/config.json`。
2. **配置文件预置**(适合团队统一):

```yaml
# cordis.patch.yml
- id: file-menu
  name: dsh-better-right-click
  config:
    items: [copy-absolute, copy-relative, reveal, open-default, open-with]
    fileManager:
      mode: auto          # auto | explorer | custom
      command: ''         # mode=custom 时生效,%1 代表文件路径
```

`items` 可选值:`copy-absolute`、`copy-relative`、`reveal`、`open-default`、`open-with`。非法项会被忽略,`items` 为空时回落全开。

非默认资源管理器:`mode: auto` 会自动读注册表(`HKCU/HKLM\Software\Classes\Folder\shell\open\command`),当你装了 Directory Opus / XYplorer / Total Commander / Files 等接管了文件夹打开的程序时,菜单会多一项「用 XXX 打开所在位置」。

### 锁定某个应用（0.4.0）

右键 → 「菜单设置…」→「锁定打开方式」：当前文件类型会列出所有能打开它的应用，选一个保存，以后这个类型的菜单顶部就固定是「用 X 打开（已锁定）」，其余应用仍可临时改选。

- 锁定按扩展名生效，只影响本插件菜单，**不会**改 Windows 的双击默认程序（改系统默认要 Windows 设置页手动点，微软不允许程序静默改）。
- 想换成没进列表的程序：右键 →「其他程序…」→ 在系统对话框里选，Windows 会记住它，下次自动出现在列表里。
- 锁定存在 `~/.dsh/better-right-click/config.json` 的 `pins` 字段，可直接编辑：

```json
{ "pins": { ".md": "C:\\Program Files\\MarkText\\marktext.exe" } }
```

## 原理

- `lib/index.js`（宿主）：`ctx.webServer.register()` 注册 4 条精确路由 `/file-menu/{open,status,reveal,open-external}`，`spawn(exe, [args])` 数组传参，零运行时依赖。
- `lib/client.js`（浏览器）：classic-script bundle（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`），捕获阶段 `contextmenu` 委托 + 纯 DOM 浮层；`exports.apply(ctx)` 安装、`exports.dispose` 卸载。
- `cordis.patch.yml`：只追加宿主条目；客户端半端由 DSH 识别 `dsh.client` 声明后自动下发。

## English

DSH web plugin adding a three-item right-click menu (**Copy absolute path** / **Reveal in Explorer** / **Open with default app**) for file references in the conversation transcript: markdown file links, `@file` mentions and tool-row file cards. Right-clicking blank text, inputs, code blocks or buttons keeps the native menu.

- Platform: **Windows 10 / 11 only** (uses the built-in PowerShell 5.1). macOS and Linux are not supported: Explorer reveal, the registered-apps list, file-manager detection and the picker dialog all depend on `explorer.exe` / PowerShell scripts; only the two copy actions would work there.
- Target build: DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` (`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`). The package declares `"os": ["win32"]`, so npm refuses to install it on other platforms.
- Install: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <name-or-tgz>` (the package declares `dsh.bundle.patch` = its `cordis.patch.yml`, so the plugin manager installs and removes it like any other bundle), restart DSH.
- Host routes: `GET /file-menu/open`, `GET /file-menu/status`, `POST /file-menu/reveal`, `POST /file-menu/open-external`. Same-origin (loopback) only, JSON errors, n

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: out-of-band progress narration for the Web UI and dsh-tui
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-progress-summary

[![test](https://github.com/tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary/actions/workflows/test.yml)

Out-of-band progress narration for DeepSeek Harness: a cheap auxiliary model turns the live
chain of thought into one short status line, shown above the composer in the Web UI and on the
dsh-tui status line.

## Where it shows

- **Web**: the row above the composer (the input dock), not the transcript's process rows.
- **dsh-tui**: the keyed status line above the prompt.
- **Switch**: Settings → General → **Show progress summary**. Turning it off cancels every
  auxiliary call and clears the TUI row immediately.
- Other knobs (model, interval, token floor, language) live on the plugin's page in Plugins.

The transcript's four work-details modes are untouched; this plugin does not add a fifth mode.

## Why out-of-band

Codex-style progress text comes from a model-side channel (`reasoning.summary` plus `commentary`
messages). DeepSeek exposes only raw `reasoning_content`, so there are two ways to approximate it:

- **Prompt nudging** (what the existing working-activity / progress-narrator plugins do): ask the
  main model to narrate each step. Cheap, but it competes with the task for output budget, and
  OpenAI's own Codex migration guide recommends removing exactly this kind of preamble prompt.
- **Out-of-band narration** (this plugin): the main model is untouched; a second, tiny request
  reads the recent reasoning and writes one line.

The cost is an extra call; the benefit is that the task never competes with its own status text.

## Trigger policy

Two layers: **free lines** update at every boundary, **model lines** fire only before a tool call.

| Trigger | Output | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Turn start (opt-in) | "Analyzing the request" | 0 |
| Every tool call (opt-in) | a line derived from the tool name and arguments | 0 |
| **Before a tool call**, with both floors met | one sentence from the auxiliary model | 1 call |
| Turn end | idle, clearing both surfaces | 0 |

The model line requires both:

1. **Time**: at least `minIntervalMs` since the last model line (default 20s).
2. **Tokens**: at least `minTokens` of new reasoning since then (default 600; `charsPerToken`
   defaults to 3, so roughly 1800 characters).

A tool call is the only trigger that starts a model line because it is the one point where the
preceding chain of thought is known to be complete: the model has committed to an action. A pause
in the stream proves nothing (network jitter, a provider that emits two tokens and stalls, ordinary
tokenization gaps), which is why there is no timer-based trigger.

Below either floor the material stays buffered and the next tool boundary re-checks. A failed call
returns the consumed characters and retries at the next boundary. Turns without tool calls get no
model line at all — a deliberate trade: rather than cut into a reasoning block, stay quiet.

The two free rows are off by default (`quickLines: false`): the dock is a summary surface, not a
second command log. The prompt also forbids naming tools, commands, or paths, because the
transcript already shows every call.

Caps: `maxPerTurn` (default 40) calls per turn, 96 output tokens per call, `effort=off`.

## Install

### From a git tag (no registry needed)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary#v0.1.0"
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add "github:tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary#v0.1.0"   # optional
```

`dsh plugin add` forwards the spec to pnpm, so any pnpm git form works:
`github:user/repo#tag`, `git+https://github.com/user/repo.git#tag`, or the plain
`https://github.com/user/repo#tag`. The tag pins the version; the package has no build step, so
pnpm clones it and installs its dependencies from the registry.

### From npm (once published)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-progress-summary
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add dsh-progress-summary   # optional: TUI
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` appends it to the profile's bundle
list; `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `progress-summary` row and `dsh.client` makes the Web client
load the browser half. The plugin deliberately depends on **no DSH core package**: the session
module and the record-append function come from the Loader's own module instance at runtime, so
installing it can never shadow the host's core packages with different versions.

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-progress-summary`.

### Local development (`link:`)

```bash
npm install --omit=dev
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$PWD"
```

`link:` is a development convenience: the profile holds a symlink, so a source edit plus a restart
is enough. It has no bearing on publishing.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; also the Settings toggle (live) |
| `provider` / `model` | `auto` | `auto` follows the session's own route; otherwise pin a route |
| `effort` | `off` | Reasoning effort for the auxiliary call |
| `maxTokens` | `96` | Output cap for one line |
| `timeoutMs` | `8000` | Abort a single call after this long |
| `minIntervalMs` | `20000` | Time floor between two model lines (live) |
| `minTokens` | `600` | Token floor at a tool boundary (live) |
| `charsPerToken` | `3` | Divisor used for the token estimate |
| `excerptChars` | `700` | Reasoning tail sent to the model |
| `maxLineChars` | `128` | Hard cap for the rendered line (characters) |
| `maxPerTurn` | `40` | Hard cap on auxiliary calls per turn (live) |
| `lang` | `auto` | `auto` follows the host locale; `zh` / `en` pin it |
| `publish` | `true` | Commit ignorable records so the Web UI receives lines |
| `tui` | `true` | Contribute the line to a composed TUI |
| `quickLines` | `false` | Opt into the free turn-start/per-tool lines |
| `subagents` | `false` | Narrate subagent sessions too |
| `debug` | `true` | Append a bounded diagnostics log under `~/.dsh/` |

Fields marked live are volatile: a save takes effect on the next tool boundary, without a restart.

## How each surface receives the line

- **Web**: the host commits `plugin:progress-summary/line` (an ignorable record, safe for resume),
  which folds into the `progressSummary` session projection. The browser reads it with
  `useProjection`; nothing is written to the model-visible history.
- **dsh-tui**: `ctx.tuiStatus.set('progress-summary', line)`, cleared at turn end. This path does
  not need the record at all.

Both profiles load the same package; only the available services differ.

## Implementation notes

- Records are committed from a microtask: `session/event` listeners run inside the session's own
  commit, where a second append is refused as re-entrant.
- The commit function is taken from the Loader entry for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`
  (`entry.moduleNamespace`), because path-resolved copies are separate ESM instances whose private
  `Session` brand does not match the live session objects.
- The auxiliary route defaults to the session's logged `request/header` route, so no separate
  credentials or model catalog entry is needed.
- A process that starts mid-turn (a restart while a turn is running) adopts that turn at the first
  tool boundary instead of staying silent until the next turn.

## Known limitations

- One ignorable record is committed per published line (roughly 10–20 per turn at the defaults);
  set `publish: false` to keep the log clean, at the cost of the Web line.
- Turns with no tool call produce no model line.
- The line is capped at 128 characters and rendered on at most two lines.
- A misconfigured provider/model fails silently; the UI simply has no line.

## Tests

```bash
npm test      # node --test, 35 cases
npm run check # syntax check of every runtime file
```

plugins.description: A persistent plugin rail for DeepSeek Harness: plugin navigation gets its own slim column, leaving the sidebar to sessions and workspaces.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-two-pane-sidebar

A persistent **plugin rail** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) — it moves the
plugin navigation out of the main sidebar into a slim column of its own, leaving the sidebar to do
one job: new session, workspaces, sessions.

```
┌──────────────┬────────────────────┬─────────────────────┐
│  plugin rail │  sidebar           │  conversation       │
│  (52/208 px) │  new session       │                     │
│  ──────────  │  workspaces        │                     │
│  ▣ plugins   │    search          │                     │
│  ▣ market    │    ▣ workspace A   │                     │
│  ▣ tasks     │    ▣ workspace B   │                     │
│  ▣ skills    │  sessions          │                     │
│  …           │                    │                     │
└──────────────┴────────────────────┴─────────────────────┘
        ↑ drawn by this plugin        ↑ untouched, shipped SidebarRoot
```

The rail is **data-driven**: it renders whatever is registered in the host's `sidebar.panellist`
slot (`{ id, order, label, component }`). Install a plugin that registers a navigation entry and it
shows up here automatically — no code change, no configuration. Unregister it and it disappears.

This plugin is **client-only**. It installs no Host behaviour, makes no network requests, sends no
telemetry, and never touches your sessions or workspaces. Its entire state is one `localStorage`
key.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| Harness | DSH Desktop / Web **0.2.1-rc.2** (Windows, macOS, Linux) |
| Runtime | none — plain ESM, no build step, no dependencies |
| Compatibility | declares `engines.dsh = ">=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0"`, see [Compatibility](#compatibility) |

## Install

Pick one. All three go through the Host's plugin manager, which writes the profile manifest, runs
`pnpm add`, and applies the bundle patch.

```bash
# 1. registry — not on npm yet, the name is reserved for a future release:
#    plugin_manager install_bundle target=@a-meng-e/dsh-two-pane-sidebar@0.2.0

# 2. release tarball — no npm account, a fixed immutable artifact
plugin_manager install_bundle target=https://github.com/A-Meng-E/dsh-two-pane-sidebar/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-two-pane-sidebar-0.2.0.tgz

# 3. straight from git
plugin_manager install_bundle target=git+https://github.com/A-Meng-E/dsh-two-pane-sidebar.git
```

Then **restart the app** (profile changes are not hot-reloaded) and reload the page.

> The spec is forwarded to `pnpm add`, so `file:` / `link:` local paths work too — that is how
> development installs work.

## Use

- Click a row to open that plugin's panel; the active row is highlighted with a left bar.
- Hover a row in the narrow rail for a themed tooltip.
- The arrow button at the bottom switches between **52 px (icons only)** and **208 px (icons +
  labels)**. It is in the same place in both widths, so it never jumps.
- The choice is stored in `localStorage["dsh.two-pane-sidebar.v2"]` and survives restarts.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the width transition.

There is no mode to configure: the rail is always on, and the sidebar always keeps its own width
(whatever you last dragged it to). The rail reserves its space with a left padding on the frame, so
the conversation column gives up 52 px — the sidebar does not shrink.

## Uninstall

```bash
plugin_manager remove_bundle target=dsh-two-pane-sidebar
```

Or quit the app first, then delete the `dsh-two-pane-sidebar` line from
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` and its entry from `dsh.profile.bundles`. Verify before
editing: editing profile files while the app is running can trip a hot-reload race in unrelated
built-in plugins.

Nothing is left behind except the `localStorage` key, which is inert.

## How it works

`client.js` is the whole thing (~670 lines, no dependencies):

1. registers a component into the host's frame-level `shell.overlay` slot;
2. locates the layout frame (`[data-shell-overlay]`.parentElement) and sets `padding-left` on it to
   reserve the rail's column — this is the only imperative DOM contact point, and it is reverted by
   the effect cleanup;
3. reads `sidebar.panellist` through `slots.entriesOfSlot()`, subscribes to slot and locale changes,
   and renders one row per entry;
4. renders each entry's own icon component directly (the host only injects `renderSlot` into entries
   that declare children, which this one does not), behind an error boundary so one broken icon
   cannot take the rail down;
5. copies the computed background/texture/text colour of the native sidebar column onto the rail, so
   third-party skins apply without any per-skin code;
6. hides the now-duplicated navigation list inside the native sidebar with one CSS rule.

Every host interaction is guarded: a missing service, slot, or DOM node degrades the rail instead of
breaking app boot.

## Compatibility

This plugin deliberately depends on host internals, all of which can change between Harness
releases:

| Depends on | Used for |
|---|---|
| `shell.overlay` slot | mounting the rail |
| `sidebar.panellist` slot + entry shape `{id, order, label, component}` | the rail's content |
| `[data-shell-overlay]` and its parent frame | reserving the column |
| `nav[class*="_panelList"]` (hashed class) | hiding the duplicated nav list |
| `[class*="sidebarCol"]` / `[class*="_root"]` (hashed class) | following the active skin |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` → `Tooltip` | themed tooltips |
| `ctx.layout.selectPanel(id)` | opening a panel on click |

If an update breaks one of them the rail degrades or disappears; it does not corrupt data. The
checklist for re-verifying after a Harness upgrade is in
[docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md).

## Known limits

- Not a native second view container: the rail lives in the overlay layer and reserves space with
  padding. There is no draggable splitter, and the rail has exactly two widths.
- The conversation column loses 52 px; the host's `viewport < 1024` "narrow window" threshold
  therefore triggers 52 px earlier than before.
- A skin that paints somewhere other than the sidebar column's own element will not be followed —
  the rail falls back to the theme tokens for that skin.
- Icon components are rendered directly and must only depend on `{ size, active }`; anything else
  degrades to a neutral placeholder square.

## Development

```bash
# link the working copy into a profile, then restart the app
plugin_manager install_bundle target=link:/absolute/path/to/two-pane-sidebar
```

`link:` installs a symlink, so after that every edit to `client.js` is picked up by a page reload —
no build, no copy step. Locale metadata (`locale/*.json` `meta`) is read at boot and needs a restart.

Filter the browser console by `[two-pane-sidebar]`; every degraded path logs a warning there.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Claude Design System theme, system fonts, and a usage panel. Design language derived from open-claude-ui.
plugins.readme_text:
# HwFee-dsh — DeepSeek Harness 插件套件 针对 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 深度打造的现代化模块化插件套件。每个插件均为独立设计与打包（位于 `plugins/` 目录下），拥有专属配置清单、补丁定义、构建流水线与自动化测试套件，支持按需独立安装、零干扰平滑启停。 ![实际对话与任务执行效果](assets/screenshot-chat.png) | 中文界面（首页衬线字体与用量统计面板） | 英文界面（CDS 令牌多语言自适应） | | :---: | :---: | | ![中文界面](assets/screenshot-zh.png) | ![英文界面](assets/screenshot-en.png) | *插件套件实机交互效果：包含 CDS 主题的暖灰表面阶梯与陶土橙强调色、首页衬线 Display 问候语、多维度用量统计面板、Agent 执行流程卡片以及输入框与代码块等组件级交互细节。* ## 设计溯源 · Design Provenance **本项目的设计语言严格对齐开源项目 [open-claude-ui](https://github.com/Caho1/open-claude-ui)** —— 该项目遵循 MIT 协议，是对 Anthropic **Claude Design System (CDS)** 进行干净室逆向还原的完备实现。本项目遵循严谨的设计系统工程实践，而非主观拼凑：从设计令牌阶梯、双环焦点态、有机动效曲线、单像素发丝边框，到诸多组件的交互规格，均逐项考证并精确复现自该规范。 **规范落地与溯源体系**： - **逐行考证**：[`docs/cds-spec.md`](docs/cds-spec.md) 详细记录了提取自参考仓库的全部规范项，每个度量与色值均精确标注原始 `文件:行号`，并附带针对上游 18 处规范冲突的详细仲裁说明； - **同步溯源**：`plugins/cds-theme/client/src/palette.js` 中所有颜色变量均内联标注规范来源注释，任何数值变更必须同步更新引证； - **环境隔离**：参考仓库作为只读克隆存放于 `.reference/`（已列入 `.gitignore`，**不纳入版本控制**），仅作为本地开发对照依据，完全解耦于构建链路。 > [!NOTE] > **关于首页交互波纹的特别说明**： > 首页点击波纹效果未包含在上游参考仓库中（规范全分支检索 `ripple` / `glyph` / `code symbol` 均为 0 命中）。该特性系复现自 Claude Code 桌面版曾短期上线的首页实验交互（参见 [anthropics/claude-code#102952](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/102952)）。 > 尽管属于扩展复现，其实现**在技术哲学上完全遵从 CDS 的既有范式**：参考仓库中唯一的 Canvas 光晕范例（`ReasoningAmbientGlow.tsx` 中的 `AmbientLightFieldCanvas`）确立了「径向渐变柔光渲染、杜绝线条描边」的核心原则 —— 首页波纹严格沿用这一光晕算法，呈现自然扩散的柔和场域，而非机械的同心几何圆环。 *The design language is derived from [open-claude-ui](https://github.com/Caho1/open-claude-ui), a clean-room reverse-engineered implementation of the Claude Design System (CDS) under the MIT license. Rather than inventing arbitrary styles, this project rigorously aligns with CDS standards: token ladders, dual-ring focus states, organic motion curves, single-stroke border disciplines, and component specifications are directly extracted with precise file:line citations documented in `docs/cds-spec.md`. The sole deliberate exception is the home-screen click ripple effect, which was not present in the reference repository (zero hits for `ripple` / `glyph` / `code symbol`) and reconstructs an experimental Claude Code desktop feature. Even so, it adheres strictly to CDS design principles by following the reference repository's canvas ambient light model (`AmbientLightFieldCanvas`) — rendering soft radial gradients without hard stroke borders.* ## 插件矩阵 · Plugins | 插件 | 目录 | 核心定位与特性 | |:---|:---|:---| | **`dsh-cds-theme`** | [`plugins/cds-theme`](plugins/cds-theme) | **Claude Design System 完整主题体系**
• 将宿主全套 `--dsw-*` 设计令牌重映射至 CDS 标准（暖灰表面阶梯、陶土橙强调色、双环焦点与有机动效）
• 输入框、侧边栏、消息行、代码块及 Markdown 渲染的组件级细节打磨
• 内嵌 Anthropic 官方可变字体，首屏问候语支持衬线 Display 排印
• 空白会话代码字形矩阵背景与交互点击波纹动效
• 长文本粘贴智能转存为轻量文件引用
• 独立挂载「主题定制」设置面板，支持色彩、暖度、圆角及阴影微调 | | **`dsh-system-fonts`** | [`plugins/system-fonts`](plugins/system-fonts) | **系统字体与排印精细化配置**
• 为正文/界面、代码块、集成终端独立提供字体族槽位
• 智能枚举 Windows 本地系统字体（融合 GDI、注册表与 OpenType 元数据）
• 提供高精度行距（Line Height）与字距（Letter Spacing）实时调节
• 纯粹专注排印布局，严格不干预主题预设字重与调色体系 | | **`dsh-usage-stats`** | [`plugins/usage-stats`](plugins/usage-stats) | **多维会话用量分析看板**
• 可视化呈现历史会话数、消息量、Token 总消耗及活跃天数
• 统计高峰活跃时段与常用模型分布，内置 GitHub 风格交互热力图
• 支持「全部历史 / 30 天 / 7 天」多时间窗口快速切换
• 高效内存缓存与异步聚合，毫秒级即时响应 | > **架构解耦保障**：三款插件各司其职、完全解耦，支持任意单独安装或组合使用。各插件严格遵循所有权隔离原则，仅声明并操作专属的设计令牌与扩展槽位，杜绝状态竞争与样式污染。 ## 快速上手 · Installation ### 1. 构建与添加插件 在目标插件目录下构建产物，并通过 `link:` 软链形式添加至宿主 Profile： ```bash # 以 cds-theme 为例：构建客户端产物（使用 link 协议时宿主不会自动触发构建） cd plugins/cds-theme && npm ci && npm run build && cd - # 将插件软链添加至指定 Profile（以 desktop Profile 为例） dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:/Users/17445/Desktop/HwFee-dsh/plugins/cds-theme ``` > [!IMPORTANT] > **必须完全重启宿主程序**： > 安装或卸载插件后，**必须彻底退出并重启 DeepSeek Harness**。插件的生命周期装载与依赖注入发生于宿主 Profile 的初始化启动阶段，无法在已运行的实例中热重载生效。 ### 2. 协议选型建议（`link:` vs `file:`） - **开发与本地使用（推荐）**：使用 `link:` 软链协议。宿主 Profile 直接指向本地工程目录，修改源码并编译后，仅需重启 DSH 即可直接生效，无需重复安装。 - **固化分发**：使用 `file:` 协议将产物完整复制至 Profile 存储目录中，适合固定发布版本。 ### 3. 卸载插件 ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-cds-theme ``` ### 4. 三种安装入口分别填什么 · What to type where DSH 有三处可以装插件，**它们接受的东西不一样**。下表是实测结果，不是推测： | 入口 | 填什么 | 实测 | |---|---|---| | **命令行** | `dsh plugin --profile

add ` | 见下 | | **GUI：设置 → 插件 → 添加插件** | 下面任一 **spec**（和命令行同一个解析器） | 走 `pluginManager.installBundle` | | **GUI：插件 → 发现**（需开启「自定义插件市场」） | 一个 **index.json 的 URL**，不是包名 | 市场源 | 命令行与 GUI 输入框接受**同一个 spec**，可用的有： ```bash # ① 本地路径（开发用，推荐） link:C:/Users/17445/Desktop/HwFee-dsh/plugins/cds-theme # ② 已发布的 npm 包名（需要先 npm publish） dsh-cds-theme @hwfee/dsh-usage-stats # ③ tarball URL（不需要 npm 账号，推荐给使用者） https://github.com/HwFee/HwFee-dsh/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-system-fonts-0.1.0.tgz # ④ 本地 tarball 文件 C:/path/to/dsh-system-fonts-0.1.0.tgz ``` **❌ git 地址装不了子目录插件。** 这条实测过，写下来免得再踩： ```bash # 下面两种写法都会失败 git+https://github.com/HwFee/HwFee-dsh.git#&path:/plugins/system-fonts https://github.com/HwFee/HwFee-dsh/tree//plugins/system-fonts ``` 原因：pnpm 处理 git 依赖时**只装仓库根**，`&path:` / `&path:plugins/...` 都被忽略。你的仓库根没有 `package.json`（更没有 `dsh.bundle`），于是： - 最好的情况：装进整个仓库、生成一个占位 `package.json`，警告 `declares no dsh.bundle — installed as a plain dependency, not a profile layer`； - 最坏的情况：直接失败。 **所以给别人装，用 ③ tarball URL；自己开发，用 ① link:。** 如果确实要走 git，必须让仓库根就是插件根（一个仓库一个插件）。 > 三个插件当前的 Release 资产： > `dsh-cds-theme-0.1.0.tgz`（7.5 MB）、`dsh-system-fonts-0.1.0.tgz`（80 KB）、`hwfee-dsh-usage-stats-0.1.0.tgz`（81 KB），见 [Releases](https://github.com/HwFee/HwFee-dsh/releases/tag/v0.1.0)。 ### 5. 发布到 npm 完整教程见 [`market/PUBLISHING.md`](market/PUBLISHING.md)，含 2FA 那道坎的两个解法。要点： - 本机 `.npmrc` 默认 registry 是 `registry.npmmirror.com`（**只读镜像，不能发布**），三个包已用 `publishConfig.registry` 钉到官方源； - npm 现在要求发布时通过 2FA：要么在**能弹浏览器的终端**里 `npm login`，要么用勾了 `bypass 2fa` 的 granular token； - **镜像站不用管**：它是单向只读同步，包进了官方 npm 后会自动出现，DSH 的镜像支持在读取侧（自动回退），不需要配置。 ## 本地开发与工作流 · Development 每个插件目录均为标准的独立包，可在各自目录下独立执行开发生命周期命令： ```bash npm ci # 安装开发依赖（仅依赖 esbuild，无任何运行时外部依赖） npm test # 执行产物新鲜度检查及全量自动化测试套件 npm run build # 编译打包客户端源码：client/src/* -> client/client.js ``` ### 关键工程约束 1. **构建产物纳入版本控制**： `client/client.js` 为随仓库提交的预编译分发文件。由于 `link:` 软链模式在宿主启动时不会自动执行编译，产物必须与源码时刻保持严格同步。`npm test` 启动时首先执行新鲜度核验（`build-client.mjs --check`），若构建产物落后于源码将直接阻断测试。 2. **LF 换行符强约束**： 仓库通过 `.gitattributes` 强制指定所有文件采用 LF 换行符。因新鲜度校验采取二进制逐字节比对，在 Windows 环境下若开启 `core.autocrlf=true`，检出的源码将携带 CRLF 换行符，经 esbuild 打包后会引入字节偏移（实测多出 83 字节），导致全新克隆环境下的自动化测试失败。 ## 质量审计与自动化验证 · Verification 仓库根目录与各插件内置了完善的自动化审计与端到端验证套件： ```bash # 仓库级架构与安全审计 # 检查项包括：体积预算红线、DOM 安全性、无动态代码注入(eval/new Function)、监听器及定时器生命周期闭环、配置契约一致性 node tools/audit.mjs # CDS 主题端到端规格验证（覆盖 73 项设计令牌、排印阶梯、样式隔离与回退断言） cd plugins/cds-theme && node tools/verify.mjs ``` ## 仓库结构 · Repository Structure ``` HwFee-dsh/ ├── plugins/ # 独立插件包目录 │ ├── cds-theme/ # Claude Design System 主题插件 │ │ ├── client/src/ # 客户端 ESM 源代码 │ │ ├── client/client.js # 预编译客户端 Bundle（提交入库） │ │ ├── lib/index.js # Host 端后台服务（字体基址注入与长粘贴智能路由） │ │ ├── locale/ # 国际化字典（en.json / zh.json） │ │ ├── test/ # 基于 node:test 的单元测试套件 │ │ └── tools/ # 专用构建、验证与基准测试脚本 │ ├── system-fonts/ # 系统字体与排印定制插件（同等工程结构） │ └── usage-stats/ # 会话用量统计分析插件（同等工程结构） ├── docs/ # 技术规范与考证依据 │ ├── cds-spec.md # CDS 设计系统全量规范（逐行引证与冲突仲裁表） │ ├── host-hooks.md # 宿主 DOM 结构、CSS 覆写点与安全样式锚点勘察 │ ├── reference-absorption-ledger.md # 上游规范吸收台账 │ ├── replication-toggles.md # 复刻特性与设置项开关约定 │ └── perf-audit.md # 性能基准测量与资源预算指标 ├── assets/ # 文档截图与静态资源 ├── skills/ # 第三方插件开发知识库（遵循 Apache-2.0） └── tools/ # 仓库级静态审计与辅助工具集 ``` ## 参考资料与技术依据 · References `docs/` 目录中的技术文档构成本仓库技术方案与设计决策的严密支撑： - [`docs/cds-spec.md`](docs/cds-spec.md) —— 逐行考证自 `open-claude-ui` 的 CDS 设计规范，包含对上游 18 处规范冲突的仲裁结论与裁定表。 - [`docs/host-hooks.md`](docs/host-hooks.md) —— 宿主 DOM/CSS 覆写点深度勘察报告：梳理可靠的 `data-*` 样式钩子、规避混淆哈希类名，以及解释 `--dsw-elevation-*` 必须使用 `!important` 样式表覆盖的技术原理。 `.reference/open-claude-ui` 为参考上游的只读克隆镜像（遵循 MIT 协议），**已列入 `.gi

plugins.description: Local-first privacy shield for DeepSeek Harness: keep plaintext local, send only placeholders to the model, restore real values in the transcript.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-privacy-shield

Local-first privacy shield for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

Keep plaintext on your machine. Send only placeholders to the model. See real values again
in your transcript.

**Version 1.0.0** · zero third-party runtime dependencies · pure ESM · Node.js 18+

---

## What it does

DSH keeps two different records of a conversation:

| Surface | What it is | Who reads it |
|---|---|---|
| **Model-visible surface** | the messages the request is built from | the model (outbound to the cloud) |
| **Human-record surface** | the original committed session events | the chat UI and local session logs |

`dsh-privacy-shield` replaces sensitive text **only in the model-visible copy**, with deterministic
placeholders of the form `<LABEL_8hexdigits>`. Your local session logs, the chat interface, and
tool execution keep the real values. When the model replies, the response stream is wrapped and
placeholders are restored — including placeholders split across stream chunks — so the assistant
message is persisted and displayed with real values.

```
What you type:      Call 张三 at 13800138000 about 京A12345.
What the model      Call <PERSON_1a2b3c4d> at <PHONE_9f8e7d6c> about <PLATE_0a1b2c3d>.
  sees:
What you see        Call 张三 at 13800138000 about 京A12345.
  in the UI:
```

## Features

- **Model-visible masking only** — a defensive patch over `Session.deriveEventMessage`
  rewrites the five surfaces (system, developer, user, assistant, tool result) as the
  model-visible copy is derived; the human-record surface is never rewritten.
- **HMAC placeholders (default)** — `<LABEL_8hex>` = first 4 bytes of
  HMAC-SHA256(label, value); the key lives in a local file (`$DSH_HOME/shield/.placeholder.key`)
  and cannot be enumerated. `placeholderHash: legacy` keeps the old FNV-1a format.
- **Response restoration** — wraps `llm/stream` and restores `text-delta`, `reasoning-delta`,
  `tool-call-delta`, and `block-end` chunks, with a carry-over buffer for split placeholders.
- **Three detection families** — 28 entity types of generic PII/credentials (including social
  insurance, housing fund, student ID, medical record, IMEI, MAC; bank cards pass Luhn), plus
  Chinese-entity rules (organization, project, system, ID number, address, person) and a user
  term list with literal and `re:` regex entries.
- **Smart vocabulary** — `/shield scan-doc <path>` extracts candidate proper nouns from local
  documents (txt/md/csv/json/code/docx); `/shield learn` mines frequent unmatched fragments from
  local session logs. Candidates enter the term list only after explicit confirmation
  (`terms adopt`). `termsFile` hot-reloads on change (fs.watch).
- **Rules-pack import/export** — `/shield export` / `/shield import` carry the term list and
  entity switches between machines (`schema: dsh-shield.rules/v1`); `--encrypt <passphrase>`
  protects a pack with AES-256-GCM + scrypt (`DSH-SHIELD-ENC/v1`), `--pass` decrypts on import.
  A pack never contains the restore table; import validation rejects `vault/values/secrets`-style
  fields outright.
- **Term file** — `termsFile` points at a line-based word list (`#`/`//` comments, `@category`
  tags); merged with inline `terms`.
- **In-memory vault** — the `placeholder → value` table never touches disk and is
  LRU-bounded; it can in principle be rebuilt by re-running the detectors over the local log.
- **Outbound audit** — per-request placeholder counts and label distribution, plus a
  detector re-run over the outbound text to flag plaintext leaks. JSONL sink on by default with
  retention cleanup; `/shield audit [days]` queries, `audit export` writes CSV.
  Counts and labels only — never plaintext.
- **Web UI** — a dock status bar plus an expandable panel (Settings / Terms / Test bench /
  Audit / Candidates). Settings groups the 28 entity types by sensitivity with a search box and
  shows an "enabled x/y" counter; Terms shows category chips and sorts entries by hit count;
  the Test bench can show an opt-in placeholder ↔ value table (off by default); the diagnostics
  badge is hidden unless enabled in Settings; an `⟳ host-version` pill plus a "restart DSH" hint
  appears when the loaded UI bundle is older than the host plugin. Sensitive actions need
  `confirm`. See `docs/CLIENT-RPC-NOTES.md` for the RPC contract (11 methods).
- **Ops commands** — `/shield pause <minutes>` temporarily passes plaintext and auto-resumes;
  `/shield doctor` runs a check-up with OK/warn lines.
- **`shield_scan` tool** — a model-callable tool that reports masking statistics (counts and
  labels only).
- **Zero runtime dependencies.** Toggleable via `/shield on|off` and `/shield enforce|observe`.

> **Image note.** This plugin does not inspect image content (no OCR); images pass through
> untouched — handle sensitive images yourself. Text-like file block contents are masked.

> **Plaintext note.** Real values in your local logs are a deliberate design choice — they are
> what makes restoration possible. Disk encryption, backup handling, and access control remain
> your responsibility. See [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md).

## How it differs from other masking plugins

Several DSH plugins mask PII before it reaches the model. The design choices here:

- **Only the model-visible copy is rewritten.** Local session logs, the chat transcript, and
  tool execution keep real values — which is what makes display-layer restoration possible.
  (Plugins that also rewrite the human-record surface trade away local readability.)
- **Placeholders are HMAC-derived** with a local key file (`$DSH_HOME/shield/.placeholder.key`),
  so they are stable across sessions but cannot be enumerated or reversed by someone who only
  sees the masked text.
- **Rules packs move between machines** — term lists and entity switches export/import as JSON,
  optionally AES-256-GCM encrypted, and a pack never contains the restore table.
- **Vocabulary mining** — `scan-doc` extracts candidate proper nouns from local documents and
  `learn` mines session history; candidates take effect only after explicit confirmation.
- **Outbound audit with plaintext re-check** — every request is re-scanned for leaks; the audit
  records counts and labels only, never plaintext.

## Quick start

1. **Install** the bundle (absolute path to this directory):
   `plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<absolute path to dsh-privacy-shield>`
2. **Restart the DSH profile** — mandatory after install, upgrade, or uninstall
   (see *Known limitations*).
3. **Configure** in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the shipped `cordis.patch.yml` is a
   working example; it already defaults to `mode: enforce`).
4. **Verify**:
   - `/shield status` — mode, surfaces, counts, derive-patch status.
   - `/shield verify 张三的手机号是13800138000` — trial masking (prints masked output only).

## Rules packs (import / export)

```
/shield export [path] [--encrypt <passphrase>]   # write terms + entity switches to a pack
/shield import <path> [--pass <passphrase>] [replace confirm]
                                                 # auto-detects encrypted packs; merge (default)
                                                 # or replace the term list
/shield rules                                    # show current pack summary (counts only)
```

- Pack schema: `dsh-shield.rules/v1` — `{ schema, exportedAt, plugin, entities, terms, notes }`.
- Packs contain **terms and entity switches only** — never the restore table. Still, a term
  list is itself sensitive; handle packs at the same classification level as your word list.
- Alternatively, set `rulesPack: "<path>"` in `cordis.patch.yml` to load a pack at startup,
  or `termsFile` for a line-based word list.

## Configuration

Full reference: [docs/CONFIG.md](docs/CONFIG.md). Summary:

| Field | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` registers nothing. |
| `mode` | `enforce` | `enforce` rewrites the model-visible surface; `observe` counts only. |
| `entities` | 26 types | Enabled entity types (see *Entity types*). |
| `placeholderHash` | `hmac` | Placeholder hash: `hmac` (HMAC-SHA256, local key file) / `legacy` (FNV-1a, enumerable). |
|

# Tentacle

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Tentacle is a curated plugin bundle for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

The name is the mission. DSH is a single-user local agent; Tentacle gives it arms into the world — identity and isolation for many users, IM channels for eight platforms, an expert library, expert teams, SSO, and whatever else lets it reach people, services and data. Installing one bundle turns the local agent into a multi-user, multi-channel, multi-expert workspace, and the bundle keeps growing.

Scope is open by design: **anything that helps DSH connect is a candidate package.** A new data source, tool or platform integration that makes DSH a first-class citizen somewhere is in scope; re-implementing what DSH already does is not.

**Multi-tenant by design.** Identity, authorization, and per-user isolation are the foundation everything else grows from — not an afterthought.

## Repository layout

```
packages/
  bundle/             dsh-tentacle-bundle — the one package users install
  profile/            profile templates for one-command setup
  plugin-identity/    pluggable identity (local single-user default, login gate, DID)
  plugin-crypto/      shared crypto envelopes (scrypt passwords, token fingerprints)
  plugin-gateway/     authenticating reverse proxy: one resolver→policy→forward pipe for HTTP/RPC/WS
  plugin-tenancy/     tenant/user namespaces: user directory, invites, policies, admin console
  plugin-channels/    IM channel gateway (Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, WeChat, Yuanbao, Discord)
  plugin-persona/     expert library: templates, workspaces, agent-preset selection
  plugin-teams/       expert teams: team objects, templates and channel bindings, on the official agent-team runtime
  plugin-oidc/        OIDC browser SSO login
examples/             minimal runnable profiles
tests/                e2e: install/enable chain via dsh headless profiles
```

## Status

Early development, usable end to end: every package builds and typechecks cleanly, the unit suite passes, and the e2e suite drives the full install → login → multi-tenant → channel → expert → team path against a real DSH process. APIs and package layout may still change.

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# 会话回收站 · Session Recycle Bin **给 DSH 补上删除会话的能力——删除即移入可恢复的回收站，子会话跟随主会话整树处理。**

DSH 没有删除会话的接口。本插件把它补上，并且做成两步：**删除 = 移入回收站**，随时可以恢复；只有「彻底删除」才真正销毁磁盘上的字节。 **[English →](README.en.md)** ## 为什么选它 能删除会话的插件不少，本插件围绕三条约定设计： - **一条条目 = 一棵树。** 一个会话名下的子代理会话不会被落下指向一个不存在的父会话。删除一个会话会带走整棵树；回收站里它是一条条目，恢复与彻底删除都把树当成一个整体。 - **不会悄悄销毁任何东西。** 删除与销毁前，确认框都会写清楚有几个子会话会跟着走；没有静默批量清空。 - **做得正。** 侧栏入口、会话菜单、模型工具三处入口共用同一批 Host 方法，行为一致。 ## 安装 插件已在 npm 发布为 **`dsh-recycle-bin`**，并已收录进 DSH 插件市场。 ```powershell dsh plugin --profile add dsh-recycle-bin ``` 也可以直接在市场里搜索 **会话回收站 / Session Recycle Bin** 点安装。装完 **刷新一次页面**（Ctrl+F5），侧栏入口会出现在「插件」「定时」「市场」那一排。 本地开发安装（源码即运行代码，不需要 build）： ``` plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "<本目录绝对路径>" } ``` ## 你能得到什么 | 位置 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | **会话右键菜单 → 红色「删除会话…」** | 先弹确认框（不会单击即删），并写明有几个子会话会一并移入 | | **会话右键菜单 →「批量操作…」** | 对某个工作区的全部会话批量归档或删除；独立确认框，写明整个选中集合带多少子会话 | | **侧栏「会话回收站」** | 主区打开完整页面：每条会话行首有复选框、行尾是恢复与彻底删除，上方是选择栏，可批量操作 | | **右键侧栏图标** | 「清空回收站…」——一键清空的捷径，同样先过写明条数的确认框 | | **设置 → 会话回收站** | 同一个回收站页，给习惯在设置里操作的人 | | **`delete_session` 工具（给模型用）** | `preview` / `trash` / `trashMany` / `archiveMany` / `list` / `restore` / `restoreMany` / `purge` / `purgeMany` / `purgeAll`，与 UI 共用同一批 Host 方法 |

删除确认框会写明带走的子会话数：

彻底删除前同样先报数：

## 一次删除做了什么 1. **先解析整棵树**：按每个会话日志 header 里的 `origin: 'subagent'` + `parentSession` 找到全部子代理会话（任意深度），不依赖侧栏当前显示什么。 2. **先过准入**：调 DSH 官方的归档准入，检查这个会话是否还有正在跑的工作（进行中的回合、后台 job、活着的子代理、定时提醒）。有工作就拒绝删除，返回 `session-open`。 3. **搬运**：会话日志与投影缓存被**移动**到 `~/.dsh/session-recycle-bin/<时间戳>-/`，并从工作区登记里摘除，侧栏行随即消失。 4. **失败全部回滚**：任何一步失败，已经搬走的东西都会搬回原位，不会丢字节。 恢复是反过程，并且**先检查整棵树的所有目标路径**再动任何一个字节：只要有一个会话会与现有目录冲突，整条恢复就被拒绝，不会出现「父会话回来了、子会话还在回收站」的半棵树。 ## 安全边界与已知限制 - **只有「还有工作」的会话会被拒绝删除。** 你若只是打开过会话，没有在跑的任务，它就能被删除，恢复后也能继续对话。 - **不会误销毁。** 清空回收站不可撤销，所以它总是走同一个确认对话框：对话框打开期间整个回收站页冻结，正文永远写明要销毁的条目数与子会话日志数。 - **永远不碰**：附件目录（`~/.dsh/attachments/v1/objects`，按内容寻址、跨会话共享）、`~/.dsh/sessions` 下的项目目录本身、以及任何同 ID 的既有会话。 - **父会话还在时，子会话不能被单独删除**（返回 `session-child`）——正确动作是删父会话。父会话已不存在的**孤儿子会话**仍可按 id 清理。 - **回收站条目仍占磁盘**，直到你显式彻底删除；没有自动过期清理。 - **Windows 上跨卷移动**会从 `rename` 回退到复制（`EXDEV`）；同卷内是原子 rename。 - **小提示**：恢复后侧栏可能需要刷新一次页面——DSH 没有「会话出现」事件可为恢复的日志合成行。 - **Auto review 权限预设**可能拒绝模型发起的 `delete_session` 写调用；那是 DSH 的权限策略，不是插件行为，改用 UI 或换权限预设即可。 ## 版本兼容 | 声明 | 值 | | --- | --- | | `engines.dsh` | `0.2.0-rc.1 \|\| 0.2.0-rc.2 \|\| 0.2.1-rc.1 \|\| 0.2.1-rc.2` | | `peerDependencies` | 10 个包：9 个 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`（同样的 `0.2.x-rc.*` 区间）+ `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.5` | **DSH 0.2 与 0.1 的插件 API 不兼容**（`settings` API 在 0.2 被移除），所以下限钉在 `0.2.0-rc.1`，而不是一个会静默排除预发布版本、让用户只看到「没有解释的 `ERESOLVE`」的宽泛区间。 ## 卸载 ``` plugin_manager { action: "remove_bundle" } ``` **回收站里尚未恢复的条目会保留**在 `~/.dsh/session-recycle-bin`。如果插件已卸载又想把会话找回来，每个条目里都有 `entry.json` 清单写明每个文件该去哪：把 `session/`（以及每个 `children//session/`）搬回 `~/.dsh/sessions///`，把 `projcache.json` 搬回 `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/.json` 即可。 ## 许可证 MIT

plugins.description: Connect DeepSeek Harness to the local Sourcebook Desktop library via MCP.
plugins.readme_text: # Sourcebook for DSH **Keep reusable research, working materials, and notes in Sourcebook across DSH sessions. Bring selected sources into a task, then hand useful work back for review.** Use the DSH workspace for files in your current project. Use Sourcebook Books for references and materials you want to find again across projects: links, files, and notes stay organized in your local library. ## Who it's for - Video and visual content creators working from reference images, clips, links, and briefs - Designers, writers, and researchers who reuse project research and working notes across deliverables - People who move between DSH sessions or agents and want useful materials and notes to remain available afterward For example, collect campaign references in a Book, ask DSH to draft a brief from selected sources, then submit the finished brief and its working notes back to Sourcebook for review. This community bundle connects DSH's built-in MCP client directly to the sourcebook-mcp helper shipped with Sourcebook Desktop. It also enables DSH's built-in sidebar browser. There is no separate adapter service and no copied pairing credential. > Independent community bundle; not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. Sourcebook Desktop must be installed and running on the same computer as DSH. ## Bring sources into a task - Open Sourcebook, check its local service, and choose a Book. - Search that Book and retrieve the sources relevant to the current task. - Prepare explicitly selected file sources as temporary context files. DSH can then read them through its normal workspace tools. - Open HTTP(S) source links in DSH's built-in sidebar browser. ### Copying link-type sources When Sourcebook is open in DSH's sidebar, it runs inside an iframe on a different origin from DSH. The sidebar currently does not grant that iframe clipboard-write permission, so copying a link-type source with Sourcebook's Copy button may fail with a Clipboard API or Permissions Policy error. To copy the link, open the same Sourcebook HTTP(S) address in a standalone browser tab and use Copy there, or select the URL text and press Command+C (macOS) or Ctrl+C. This is a limitation of the embedded browser's clipboard permissions; the plugin cannot change the iframe permission. File-source copy may use a different path and can continue to work. ## Hand useful work back When DSH creates something worth keeping, ask it to propose new text, import a named local file, or update source metadata in a Book. The proposals appear in Sourcebook for you to accept or reject; the library changes only after you accept. New text and files can include a note about their origin or intended use, so the next session has context too. For handoff to another agent, Sourcebook Desktop's **Pack** copies selected materials to the clipboard for pasting into that agent. Ongoing project materials and one-off tasks can stay organized in the same library. ## Try it - “Open Sourcebook and find the references in my Launch Book for this project.” - “Use the selected sources to draft a brief, then submit the final text to my Launch Book with a note about its purpose.” - “Import this local file into my Launch Book and open Sourcebook so I can review the submission.” ## Requirements & install **Requirements:** DeepSeek Harness with the built-in @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, Sourcebook Desktop installed and running on the same computer, and macOS. The default helper path in this bundle targets the standard macOS app location. **Download Sourcebook Desktop:** [macOS (Apple silicon) DMG — click to download](https://github.com/Yanze-He/sourcebook-for-agents/releases/download/v0.1.1-beta.6/sourcebook-desktop-installer-v0.1.1-beta.6.dmg) ### DSH Desktop 1. Open DSH Desktop and go to **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**. 2. Enter the repository URL: https://github.com/Yanze-He/dsh-sourcebook, then complete the Add plugin flow. 3. Restart DSH. Start a new conversation and ask it to open Sourcebook and list your Books. DSH will launch Sourcebook Desktop and return a local HTTP(S) link; click it to open the app in DSH's sidebar browser. ### DSH Web profile Run: dsh plugin --profile web add github:Yanze-He/dsh-sourcebook For HTTP(S) links returned by Sourcebook to open in the sidebar browser, set DSH's **Link opening method** to **In-app sidebar**. Public and loopback HTTP(S) links are supported. The browser rejects file:, data:, blob:, and DSH's own origin. ## If Sourcebook is installed somewhere else The bundled patch uses this standard macOS application path: /Applications/Sourcebook Desktop.app/Contents/Resources/agent-plugin/.agents/plugins/sourcebook/bin/sourcebook-mcp If your app is installed elsewhere, update the command value in cordis.patch.yml to the actual helper path, then install the local checkout into the DSH profile with: dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-sourcebook-plugin.

plugins.description: Douyin tools for DeepSeek Harness: dy-cli reads with an Edge XHR fallback, QR/SMS login state machine, account fingerprint, guarded comment.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-douyin-toolkit

把抖音接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)，作为 DSH 的一等公民工具：热榜、搜索、视频、用户、状态自检，外加一套**可轮询的扫码/短信登录状态机**和一条**默认 dry-run 的受控评论**。发布只保留接口，不执行。

> 这是一个 Cordis Host 插件，不是 MCP server；工具直接注册到 `ctx.tools`。

## 和已有项目的区别

GitHub 上已经有一些同类项目。这个仓库不是从零重复造轮子，而是把它们的成熟部分组合成一个完整的 DSH 工具插件：

| 项目 | 关系 |
|---|---|
| [`Youhai020616/douyin`](https://github.com/Youhai020616/douyin)（`dy-cli`） | **直接复用**：热榜、搜索、用户资料的逆向接口、cookie 读取、错误码和 JSON 信封都在这里 |
| [`Kuhakucai/douyin-mcp`](https://github.com/Kuhakucai/douyin-mcp) | 登录态判定（`localStorage.HasUserLogin`）、专用 profile、单 worker 的设计参考 |
| [`WJZ-P/douyin-upload-mcp-skill`](https://github.com/WJZ-P/douyin-upload-mcp-skill) | 多阶段登录状态机的设计参考 |
| [`NanmiCoder/MediaCrawler`](https://github.com/NanmiCoder/MediaCrawler) | `search_id` 链式翻页、翻页风控等已知坑 |
| [`nisew2/dsh-whale-dive`](https://github.com/nisew2/dsh-whale-dive) | 最接近的 DSH 插件：用真实 Edge/CDP 读抖音 hot/feed/video/search/status，只读 |
| [`canadaeee/dsh-douyin`](https://github.com/canadaeee/dsh-douyin) | 同生态，但做的是企业号私信通道，不是内容工具 |

和 `dsh-whale-dive` 的主要差异：

- 只读路径优先走 `dy-cli` 的逆向 API（更快、更省浏览器），接口失效时才回退到页面 XHR；
- 有 `login_start -> login_status -> login_submit` 的扫码/短信状态机，而不是只看 cookie 是否存在；
- 有用户作品、账号指纹、单条评论、发布接口占位；
- 有单 worker、3–8 秒页间抖动、小时配额和指数退避。

## 工具

| 工具 | 入参 | 说明 | 通道 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `douyin_hot` | `count?` | 热榜条目、热度、搜索链接 | 逆向 API |
| `douyin_search` | `keyword`, `limit?`, `pages?`, `cursor?`, `sort?` | 搜索；`next_cursor` 走 `search_id` 链式分页 | 逆向 API |
| `douyin_video` | `aweme_id` 或 `url`, `comment_limit?` | 文案、作者、互动数据、前 N 条评论 | 逆向 API → 浏览器 XHR 回退 |
| `douyin_user` | `user` 或 `sec_uid`, `post_limit?` | 简介、粉丝、近期作品 | 逆向 API + 浏览器 XHR |
| `douyin_status` | — | 一句话结论、登录态、配额、上次错误 | 本地 |
| `douyin_login_start` | — | 打开专用 Edge，返回 `qrcode` 和截图路径 | 浏览器 |
| `douyin_login_status` | — | 轮询 `idle/qrcode/sms_*/challenge_required/logged_in/expired/failed/stopped` | 本地/浏览器 |
| `douyin_login_submit` | `codes` | 提交 4–8 位短信验证码 | 浏览器 |
| `douyin_verify` | `keyword?`, `timeout_seconds?` | 打开验证页让你手动过滑块/验证，插件只轮询 | 浏览器 |
| `douyin_comment` | `aweme_id` 或 `url`, `content`, `dry_run?`, `confirm?` | 单条评论；`dry_run` 默认 `true` | 浏览器 |
| `douyin_publish` | 接口参数 | 恒返回 `implemented:false`，不发请求 | — |

## 架构

```
DSH Cordis 插件（dsh-douyin-toolkit）
  ├─ 工具注册 / 参数校验 / 错误码 / 限频 / 配额 / 并发锁 / 日志脱敏
  ├─ 只读后端：dy-cli（子进程）
  │    ├─ 热榜、用户资料、视频详情：python -m dy_cli.main <cmd> --json-output
  │    └─ 搜索：python dy_query.py search（复用 dy-cli client，只补 offset + search_id）
  └─ 浏览器后端：系统 Edge（Playwright，独立 profile）
       ├─ 扫码 / 短信登录状态机
       ├─ 视频详情与评论：截获页面自己发出的签名 XHR
       ├─ 用户作品：截获页面自己发出的签名 XHR
       └─ 单条评论
```

插件本身不实现 X-Bogus、不重写登录协议、不绕过验证码。

## 环境要求

- Windows（当前只在 Windows 上实测；代码里没有 Windows 专属 API，但 Edge 路径发现和 profile 清理是 Windows 优先）
- Python 3.10+（实测 3.14）
- Node.js 22+（DSH 自带）
- 系统已安装 Microsoft Edge。默认路径：
  `C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe`
- 不需要 `playwright install chromium`，也不使用 Chrome

## 安装

### 方式 A：克隆到固定目录（推荐）

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/SakuraMat0u/dsh-douyin-toolkit.git
cd dsh-douyin-toolkit
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r python\requirements.txt
```

然后用插件管理器把它作为本地 bundle 安装，target 传这个克隆目录的绝对路径：

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target = <克隆目录>
```

或者用 DSH 的插件命令：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <克隆目录的绝对路径>
```

这样 `.venv` 就在插件包旁边，`pythonPath` 不需要额外配置，`data/` 也默认落在这个目录里。

### 方式 B：直接从 GitHub 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:SakuraMat0u/dsh-douyin-toolkit
```

pnpm 安装的是包副本，不会带 `.venv`。安装后需要在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里补两项配置：

```yaml
- id: douyin
  name: dsh-douyin-toolkit
  config:
    pythonPath: C:\path\to\python.exe   # 已安装 dy-cli 和 playwright 的解释器
    dataDir: C:\path\to\writable\dir    # 专用 Edge profile、cookie、日志都写这里
```

无论哪种方式，改完配置后重启 DSH。

## 挂载与配置

bundle 自带 `cordis.patch.yml`，安装时会插入：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: douyin
      name: dsh-douyin-toolkit
      config:
        enabled: true
        writesEnabled: false
        ...
```

不要再用 `insert` 手工挂同一个 id；要改配置，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 顶层加同 id 覆盖行：

```yaml
- id: douyin
  name: dsh-douyin-toolkit
  config:
    writesEnabled: true
    maxSearchPages: 2
```

或者用启动时的额外 patch 层：

```powershell
dsh --profile desktop --patch <仓库>\examples\standalone.patch.yml
```

配置合成结果可以用 `dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` 检查。

### 配置项

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 关闭后不注册任何工具 |
| `writesEnabled` | `false` | 写操作总开关；为 false 时 `douyin_comment` 只返回 `writes_disabled` |
| `toolEnabled` | 全部 `true` | 每条工具单独开关：`hot` / `search` / `video` / `user` / `status` / `login` / `verify` / `comment` / `publish`；设为 `false` 就不注册该工具 |
| `maxResults` | `20` | 单次返回上限，硬上限 20 |
| `maxSearchPages` | `3` | 单次搜索最多翻页数，硬上限 3 |
| `hourlyRequestBudget` | `60` | 滚动 1 小时的后端请求预算 |
| `pageDelayMinMs` / `pageDelayMaxMs` | `3000` / `8000` | 翻页之间的高斯抖动区间 |
| `callDelayMinMs` / `callDelayMaxMs` | `1800` / `3200` | 独立调用之间的最小间隔 |
| `pythonPath` | 空 | 默认 `<插件目录>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe` |
| `dataDir` | 空 | 默认 `<插件目录>\data` |
| `edgePath` | 空 | 默认自动发现系统 Edge |
| `logLevel` | `info` | `silent` / `error` / `info` / `debug` |

## 登录状态机

1. `douyin_login_start`：打开独立 Edge（`<dataDir>\browser-profile`），返回 `phase: qrcode` 和二维码截图路径。
2. 用抖音 App 扫码，在手机上确认。
3. 轮询 `douyin_login_status`。成功后插件把 `storage_state` 写到
   `<dataDir>\home\.dy\cookies\default.json`（`dy-cli` 读取的路径），并记录 `sec_uid`、昵称和作品指纹。
4. 若切到验证码登录：先自己填手机号，再调用 `douyin_login_submit` 传 `codes`。
5. 若出现滑块/安全验证：插件不会绕过。调用 `douyin_verify` 打开可见窗口，手动完成后重试。

只有同时满足以下条件才判定为已登录：

- 页面 `localStorage.HasUserLogin` 为真，或
- cookie 中存在 `sessionid` / `sessionid_ss`（兜底）

两者都拿不到时返回 `unknown`，不会武断报「未登录」，也不会自动触发重新登录。

`login_start` 每次启动都会重置登录状态；换号后旧 `sec_uid` 不会沿用。账号与首次记录不一致时，写工具返回 `account_mismatch`，删除 `<dataDir>\state\account.json` 后重试。

## 风控与数据语义

- 全局单 worker，并发 1；所有 dy / 浏览器调用串行。
- 翻页之间 3–8 秒高斯抖动；独立调用之间 1.8–3.2 秒。
- 滚动 1 小时请求预算，默认 60；`douyin_status` 显示已用/剩余。
- 触发 `rate_limited` / `challenge_required` 后指数退避（1、2、4、8、15 分钟），不立即重试。
- 搜索返回 `verify_check` 时映射为 `challenge_required`，不会静默返回 0 条。
- 缺失字段一律 `null`，不填 0、不猜。
- 部分成功返回 `partial: true` + `failures[]` + `coverage`。
- 分页使用不透明 `next_cursor`，不要用页码推算。
- 错误码固定：`not_authenticated` / `challenge_required` / `rate_limited` / `not_found` / `parse_failed` / `profile_in_use` / `backend_unavailable`；写操作另有 `account_mismatch`、`invalid_args`。
- cookie、`sessionid`、`passport_*`、`localStorage`、`storage_state` 不会进入工具返回值、日志或报错。

## 故障排查

| 现象 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| `profile_in_use` | 专用 profile 已被登录窗口占用；先 `douyin_login_status`，或关闭那个 Edge 窗口。插件只会清理命令行里带本插件 profile 的 Edge 进程。 |
| `not_authenticated` | 调用 `douyin_login_start` 重新扫码；不会静默重试。 |
| `challenge_required` | 调用 `douyin_verify`，在可见窗口手动完成验证。 |
| `backend_unavailable` + 找不到 Python | 检查 `<插件目录>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe` 是否存在，或配置 `pythonPath`。 |
| `backend_unavailable` + Playwright 启动失败 | 确认 Edge 路径；插件会先清理自己的残留 Edge 再重试一次。Edge 自动更新替换 `msedge.exe` 时属于偶发断连，重启登录即可。 |
| 控制台中文乱码 | 插件已给子进程设置 `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` / `PYTHONUTF8=1`；手工执行时也要设置。 |
| 搜索/详情为空 | 先看 `douyin_status` 的 `last_error`；如果是 `challenge_required`，按上一条处理。 |
| `dataDir` 不可写 | 方式 B 从 pnpm 安装时尤其常见；把 `dataDir` 指到一个可写目录。 |

插件把子进程的 `USERPROFILE` / `HOME` / `TMP` / `TEMP` 都重定向到 `<dataDir>\home` 和 `<dataDir>\tmp`，因此 `dy-cli` 的 `~/.dy` 落在插件数据目录内，不会污染日常 `.dy` 或浏览器 profile。

## 自检

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\selfcheck.ps1
```

它会打印 Python/Edge 探测结果、桥接状态和一次真实热榜（3 条）。在 DSH 里也可以直接调用 `douyin_status`。

## 加一个新工具

1. 在 `lib/tools.js` 的 `createTools()` 数组里加一个 `defineTool({...})`。
2. `parameters` 用作者 DSL：属性上的 `required: true` 会被本地 `defineTool` 提升为对象级 `required`。
3. 只读命令优先走 `backend.runDy([...])` 或 `backend.runDyQuery([...])`；需要浏览器时走 `backend.runBrowser(command, [...])`。
4. 结果先用 `lib/normalize.js` 归一化，再 `return backendNote({...})`；不要返回 cookie/localStorage。
5. 在 `cordis.patch.yml`、`README.md` 和 `lib/tools.js` 的开关映射里补一行，重新安装 bundle。

## 能力边界

能做的：

- 读热榜、按关键词搜索、`search_id` 链式翻页、读视频详情与前 N 条评论、读用户资料与近期作品。
- 用专用 Edge profile 扫码/短信登录，状态可轮询、可中断、可重试。
- 发出**单条**评论（默认 dry-run，且默认 `writesEnabled:false`）。

不能做 / 不做的：

- 批量评论、批量点赞、批量关注、私信群发、养号、多账号矩阵。
- 自动过验证码、接打码平台、新的签名逆向。
- headless 运行这个小号。
- 未经确认的发布；`douyin_publish` 只保留接口。

明显提高风控的操作：

- 高

plugins.description: Model-driven, lossy context decay for DeepSeek Harness. Requires a patched DSH host; not a drop-in plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-decay

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Model-driven, **lossy** context decay for DeepSeek Harness.

The model decides when and what to compress. Finished spans are replaced by
self-written summaries; the current turn is always kept. There is no recovery:
the summary is the only surviving record.

> **Install note:** This is a **manual-install** plugin: it requires a DSH
> checkout with the `modelMessageDecoration` seam and is not a drop-in
> plugin-market bundle (see [Requirements](#requirements)).

![Sidebar panel: effective-window pressure, total-window occupancy, reminder state, and context-ordered position space](docs/assets/panel.png)

## What it does

- **Inline position anchors.** Every model-addressable message with a visible
  text block is prefixed with `⟦p<number>⟧`; tool-call-only assistant turns are
  unanchored by design. Compression ranges use those anchors directly:
  `⟦p<from>⟧ summary ⟦p<to>⟧`. Anchors are presentation, never part of the content.
- **Copied anchors removed.** If the model starts a reply with one or more
  anchors, the leading run is stripped at the request boundary and again before
  the reply is committed, so the transcript and later requests stay clean.
- **Model-selected spans.** The model calls `compress` with one or more
  half-open ranges and writes each summary itself. No extra summarizer request.
  Split around content that must stay live; pass all consumed spans in one call
  so the prefix is not invalidated repeatedly.
- **Lossy by design.** Compressed content is gone. There is no `decompress`, no
  original-text search, and no external table. The summary must be self-contained.
- **Tool results are compressible.** All results of one assistant tool-call
  message must stay in the same span. A boundary inside that group is rejected;
  the plugin never silently widens a span.
- **Current turn protection.** The active turn and its tool results cannot be
  compressed. If the turn starts with unanchored system/runtime messages, a `to`
  boundary at its first visible anchor keeps those messages and compresses only
  the history before the turn; `"end"` remains the end-of-compressible-history
  sentinel.
- **Tiered re-compression.** Compressing a live summary block again produces a
  tier-2 summary; larger merges increase the tier. `drop` removes a block
  completely with no tombstone.
- **Pressure without automation.** The plugin reports context pressure and
  injects reminders when context grows noticeably or crosses a warning level.
  It never compresses automatically; the model decides.
- **Live panel + audit.** A sidebar panel shows pressure, blocks, positions,
  request counts, and the reminder ledger. An optional JSONL audit records each
  request and compression.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** with the local host patch in
  [`patches/dsh-model-message-decoration.patch`](patches/dsh-model-message-decoration.patch)
  applied. Stock DSH does not expose the decoration seam; there is no runtime
  fallback. Installation alone is not enough: rebuild the host after patching.
- Node.js **>= 22.19**.
- A web profile. The client half needs the sidebar/session/locale UI packages
  listed in `package.json`.
- The bundle patch disables official **automatic** compaction
  (`compaction-basic.auto: false`), keeps the manual `/compact` command, and
  disables the in-place surface rewriters (`tool-result-pruner`,
  `image-offload`) when those rows exist. `/compact` remains an emergency
  host fallback; its checkpoint is not a context-decay block.

## Install

Manual patched install:

```bash
# 1. Apply the host patch to a DSH checkout and rebuild the host.
git -C /path/to/deepseek-harness apply /path/to/dsh-context-decay/patches/dsh-model-message-decoration.patch
pnpm -C /path/to/deepseek-harness install
pnpm -C /path/to/deepseek-harness build

# 2. Install this plugin into a profile (checkout or tarball).
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-context-decay
# or: dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-context-decay-0.1.0.tgz

# 3. Restart the web server and open the profile.
dsh web --profile web
```

See [`docs/INSTALL.md`](docs/INSTALL.md) for the full patched-checkout workflow,
Windows commands, verification, updating, and rollback.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `compress({spans:[{from,to,summary,topic?}]})` | Replace one or more half-open ranges with self-written summaries. `from`/`to` are visible anchor texts such as `"⟦p12⟧"` (bare `"p12"` and integer `12` also work); `to` may also be `"end"`. Several non-overlapping spans per call are allowed. Tool-group edges are rejected. |
| `drop({from,to})` | Remove exactly one live summary block. Use the block's printed anchor pair; `"end"` is allowed for a tail block. No tombstone, no recovery. |

A live summary block prints its pair inline as `⟦p<from>⟧ summary ⟦p<to>⟧`; use that
pair for `drop`. The sidebar panel shows pressure and the block ledger, so no
extra status tool is needed.

Examples:

```text
# one span
compress({spans:[{from:"⟦p4⟧", to:"⟦p9⟧", summary:"Read the three requirements files; constraints are ..."}]})

# two non-overlapping spans in one call
compress({spans:[
  {from:"⟦p4⟧", to:"⟦p9⟧", summary:"Read the requirements; constraints are ..."},
  {from:"⟦p9⟧", to:"end", summary:"Implemented the parser and tests; ..."}
]})

# drop one live summary block
drop({from:"⟦p4⟧", to:"⟦p9⟧"})
```

The anchor ids above are illustrative; use anchors visible in the current
session.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Enable the plugin. |
| `contextWindowTokens` | route value | Override the total context window. |
| `reservedOutputTokens` | route value | Override the reserved output budget. |
| `defaultContextWindowTokens` | `128000` | Fallback when the route has no window. |
| `growthTokens` | `20000` | Normal reminder after this much growth since the last reminder. |
| `warnRatios` | `[0.70, 0.81, 0.95]` | Warning levels as fractions of the effective window. |
| `reminderCooldownTurns` | `1` | Minimum turns between reminders. |
| `maxSpansPerCall` | `8` | Maximum spans in one `compress` call. |
| `minSummaryChars` | `20` | Minimum summary length. |
| `maxSummaryChars` | `8000` | Maximum summary length. |
| `maxMissTokens` | `null` | Optional one-time miss guard. |
| `maxPaybackRequests` | `null` | Optional payback guard. |
| `audit` | `false` | Write request/compression audit JSONL. |
| `debug` | `false` | Verbose plugin logging. |

The **effective window** is `total window - reserved output`. The model sees
pressure as a fraction of the effective window. The panel labels that percentage
as effective pressure, shows the total and reservation, and adds a total-window
occupancy line for direct comparison with the built-in context meter. Pressure,
reminder, and request facts are kept per session, so switching sessions updates
the panel.

## How it works

The host patch adds a `modelMessageDecoration` service. The plugin registers a
decoration provider that prefixes the messages selected by the replay state;
the agent loop, token meter, and request payload all apply the same decoration.
Positions come from the replayed surface, not from message text. Compressions
append `compaction/start`, `compaction/summary`, a replacement user message, and
`compaction/end`; replay rebuilds blocks, tiers, and the free list.

See [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) for the state model,
invariants, and failure modes.

See [`docs/PROMPTS.zh-CN.md`](docs/PROMPTS.zh-CN.md) for a Chinese translation of
the model-facing prompts, tool descriptions, reminders, and error copy.

## Limitations and non-goals

- **No recovery.** There is no decompress, search, or spill archive. This is
  deliberate; it is also the main trade-off.
- **Requires a patched host.** The decoration seam is not upstream. Without it
  the plugin cannot safely present anchors or replay positions.
- **No automatic compression.** Reminders are advisory. A model may ignore them;
  the budget stays protected by the request guard, not by silent compaction.
  The official automatic policy is off; manual `/compact` remains

plugins.description: Fixes the buddy / workbuddy channel 400 (code 11128, "Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel") in DeepSeek Harness, and re-applies the fix after every dsh-our-free-model upgrade.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tencent-channel-fix

Fixes the `400` / `code 11128` returned by the **buddy** and **workbuddy** channels in DeepSeek Harness, and keeps it fixed across upgrades.

> `请求被拦截，请重新发送` · `Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel` · `INVALID_REQUEST`

Every new conversation dies on the first message, with nothing useful in the error. The message names neither the header nor the sentence that the gate actually rejected.

---

## What is actually wrong

Tencent's channel gate rejects **two** independent things inside the request. Both must be fixed; fixing one still returns `400`.

### 1. The attribution User-Agent

`dsh-our-free-model/adapter/kernel.js` publishes the harness identity as the request's `User-Agent`:

```
deepseek-harness/0.2.1-rc.2 (+https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
```

The `deepseek-harness` token is on the gate's blocklist. The check is **case-insensitive** — `DeepSeek-Harness/0.2.1` is rejected too. Every other UA tested was accepted, including `curl`, `node`, `axios`, `undici`, `codex_cli_rs`, `claude-cli`, `opencode`, and the empty UA.

### 2. The harness identity sentence in the system prompt

DSH's base system prompt opens with:

```
You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.
```

The gate treats `powered by DeepSeek Harness` as a **content fingerprint** and rejects the whole request when it appears in the system message.

This one is subtle: `dsh-our-free-model` already has a fingerprint-rewriting mechanism (`rewriteTencentContentFingerprints`), but it only runs on the **gateway** path (`convertMessage` / `toMessages`). The **direct adapter** path — the one `buddy` actually uses — assembled its system message with a bare `messages.unshift(...)` and never called the rewriter. So the sentence went out verbatim.

Measured on the real endpoint:

| Request | Result |
| --- | --- |
| stock system prompt + stock UA | `400` `code 11128` |
| stock system prompt + fixed UA | `400` `code 11128` |
| rewritten system prompt + fixed UA | `200 OK` |

The same gate also rejects `Main branch (you will usually use this for PRs)`, `You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.`, and `x-anthropic-billing-header` — which is why CLI-proxy projects hit the identical error. This plugin fixes the two that DSH itself sends.

---

## Why a plugin, and not a patch

Both defects are text inside `dsh-our-free-model`. Its updater rewrites those files wholesale, so a hand edit is lost on its next update — **that is exactly how this bug comes back**. It was fixed by hand once, returned after the plugin updated, and had to be fixed again.

This plugin repairs the two files on every boot instead:

- Written **once**, in `apply()`, before any model request — `pack.js` and `adapter/kernel.js` are imported lazily by that plugin on first use, so the write lands well ahead of the module cache.
- **Idempotent**: a repaired file is detected by marker and left byte-identical.
- **Drift-aware**: if upstream moves an anchor, that patch is skipped and reported — never forced, never half-written.
- **Self-reverting**: files are backed up before writing and `node --check`-ed after; any failure restores the originals.

An upgrade of `dsh-our-free-model` becomes a self-healing event instead of a regression.

---

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-tencent-channel-fix
```

Or from this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin add github:basaltfold/dsh-tencent-channel-fix
```

Then restart DSH once. The boot log shows one of:

```
[dsh-tencent-channel-fix] repair applied — applied attribution-user-agent, content-fingerprints, direct-system-rewrite. Active from the next model request.
[dsh-tencent-channel-fix] repair incomplete (upstream dsh-our-free-model changed) — drifted ...
```

---

## Commands

### `/tencent-fix`

| Argument | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| *(none)* / `status` | Patch state for all three patches, plus the resolved target and version |
| `apply` | Force the repair now; prints what landed and what had drifted |
| `restore` | Put the newest backup back, undoing the repair |
| `why` | The root-cause explanation, in-conversation |

```
dsh-tencent-channel-fix · patch revision 1
target: C:\Users\you\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-our-free-model
dsh-our-free-model: 2.5.7

OK      attribution-user-agent — Attribution User-Agent (400 / code 11128)
OK      content-fingerprints — Rejected system-prompt fingerprints (400 / code 11128)
OK      direct-system-rewrite — Direct adapter path system rewrite (400 / code 11128)

3/3 patches in place.
```

### `GET /dsh-tencent-channel-fix`

The same status as JSON, loopback-only. `405` for anything but `GET`; mutations stay on the slash command.

---

## Configuration

Optional, in the bundle row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: tencent-channel-fix
      name: 'dsh-tencent-channel-fix'
      config:
        autoApply: true    # false = report drift only, never write
        target: ''         # explicit dsh-our-free-model directory
        verbose: false     # log every step, including no-op boots
```

`target` is resolved automatically from the active profile when empty — `${profile}/node_modules/dsh-our-free-model`, then Node's own resolution paths, then `~/.dsh/profiles/*/node_modules/`.

---

## Scope

- Touches exactly two files, both inside `dsh-our-free-model`: `adapter/kernel.js` and `vendor/channel-pack/pack.js`.
- Nothing else changes: no provider, model row, route, credential, or DSH file.
- The content rewrite is **provider-scoped** inside `pack.js` (`TENCENT_PROVIDERS = ["buddy", "workbuddy"]`), so every other channel passes through untouched.
- Attribution stays meaningful: the User-Agent remains present and non-empty and keeps its version — only the blocked token and URL are dropped.

---

## Verify

```bash
npm test        # 29 tests, no network, no real install touched
```

The suite builds targets in a temp directory from fixtures that reproduce both shipped shapes — `kernel.js` in LF, `pack.js` in CRLF — and covers idempotency, line-ending preservation, ambiguity detection, per-patch drift, dry-run, and backup restore. It also extracts the injected `sanitizeAttributionUserAgent` via `new Function` and asserts its real output.

To confirm against a live install without writing anything:

```bash
node -e "import('dsh-tencent-channel-fix/patcher').then(m => console.log(m.formatStatus(m.resolveTarget({}))))"
```

---

## Compatibility

DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1`. Verified against `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2` with `dsh-our-free-model` `2.5.6` (stock, 0/3) and `2.5.7` (3/3).

If a future `dsh-our-free-model` moves an anchor, `/tencent-fix status` reports the patch as `drifted` with the reason, and the repair is skipped rather than forced. Re-derive the anchor from the new file and bump `PATCHES` in `lib/patcher.js`.

---

## Related

- [buddy-proxy#14](https://github.com/wnddd839/buddy-proxy/issues/14) — same gate, owner confirms the rejection is triggered by system-prompt wording, not headers
- [magpie#182](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/182) — same `11128`, same cause
